"""The W runtime launcher (Stage 13a step 6): valid shell, and every command it runs exists."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import shlex
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from kintsugi.cli import _build_parser
from kintsugi.crew import runtime
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LAUNCHER = REPO / "scripts" / "w-runtime.sh"


def _commands(prefix: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    """``uv run <prefix> …`` invocations, continuation lines joined, variables replaced."""
    text = LAUNCHER.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\\\n", " ")
    found = []
    for match in re.finditer(rf"uv run {re.escape(prefix)} ([^)\n|&]*)", text):
        found.append(shlex.split(re.sub(r"\$\{?[A-Z_]+\}?", "1", match.group(1))))
    return found


def test_the_launcher_is_valid_bash() -> None:
    bash = proc.which("bash")
    if bash is None:
        pytest.skip("bash is not installed")
    result = proc.run([bash, "-n", LAUNCHER.as_posix()], timeout_s=30)
    assert result.ok, result.stderr


def test_every_kintsugi_command_in_the_launcher_parses() -> None:
    commands = _commands("kintsugi")
    assert len(commands) >= 7
    parser = _build_parser()
    for argv in commands:
        parser.parse_args(argv)  # SystemExit on an unknown command or option


def test_the_launcher_runs_the_w_crew_factory() -> None:
    text = LAUNCHER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "--crew kintsugi.crew.runtime:crew" in text
    assert callable(runtime.crew)
    for argv in _commands("python -m kintsugi.crew.runtime"):
        assert argv[0] in ("check", "start-anchors")
    assert "pip install" not in text
    assert "apt" not in text.split()  # it installs nothing
"""The W crew factory (Stage 13a step 1): the branch ledger, the T0 signer, anchors, the lane."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from kintsugi.control.genesis import write_genesis
from kintsugi.control.ship import LocalShipper
from kintsugi.crew import runtime
from kintsugi.crew.notary import Notary
from kintsugi.crew.runtime import RuntimeConfig, RuntimeConfigError, SabotageConfig
from kintsugi.crew.upstream import UpstreamLane
from kintsugi.proof import attest
from kintsugi.proof.audit import WINDOW_FILE
from kintsugi.proof.ledger_branch import BranchLedger
from kintsugi.proof.sealed import new_identity
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc
from tests.helpers.checkpoints import git


@pytest.fixture
def world(tmp_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if proc.which("git") is None:
        pytest.skip("git is not installed")
    origin = tmp_path / "origin.git"
    proc.run(["git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", str(origin)], timeout_s=30, check=True)
    repo = tmp_path / "omega"
    proc.run(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", str(repo)], timeout_s=30, check=True)
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Surya Prasanth R")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "suryaprasanthcse@gmail.com")
    (repo / ".kintsugi").mkdir()
    (repo / ".kintsugi" / "holdout.sha256").write_text("# manifest\n", encoding="utf-8")
    signer = attest.Ed25519Signer.generate()
    keys = tmp_path / "keys"
    keys.mkdir()
    signer.save(keys / "attest-t0", keys / "attest-t0.pub")
    (repo / ".kintsugi" / "attest.pub").write_text(signer.public_key_openssh() + "\n",
                                                   encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
    git(repo, "remote", "add", "origin", str(origin))
    git(repo, "push", "-q", "origin", "main")
    t0 = (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=5)).replace(microsecond=0)
    write_genesis(repo, github_repo="o/r", rulesets=[7], t0=t0.isoformat())
    cfg = RuntimeConfig(repo=repo, t0_key=keys / "attest-t0", crew_model="offline",
                        state=tmp_path / "state")  # fmt: skip
    return {"repo": repo, "origin": origin, "signer": signer, "keys": keys, "cfg": cfg,
            "tmp": tmp_path}  # fmt: skip


def test_the_crew_appends_to_the_ledger_branch_and_pushes_signed_anchors(
    world: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    crew = runtime.build(world["cfg"])
    assert isinstance(crew.ledger, BranchLedger)
    assert isinstance(crew.shipper, LocalShipper)  # no GitHub: practice runs only
    assert crew.sabotage is None
    wired = runtime.describe(crew)
    assert wired["ledger"] == "refs/heads/ledger"
    assert wired["seq"] == 1
    assert wired["model"] == "offline"
    assert wired["signer"] == attest.fingerprint(
        attest.load_public_key(world["signer"].public_key_openssh())
    )
    step: Any = None
    crew.do_ledger_append(step, {"type": "transition", "incident": "INC-0001"})
    tag = crew.do_anchor_ledger(step, 0)
    assert tag.startswith("anchor-")
    post = (world["tmp"] / "state" / "anchors" / f"{tag}.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert post.startswith(f"KINTSUGI-Ω ledger anchor {tag}\nseq 2  h ")
    repo, origin = world["repo"], world["origin"]
    assert git(origin, "rev-parse", "refs/heads/ledger") == git(repo, "rev-parse", "ledger")
    assert git(origin, "rev-parse", f"refs/tags/{tag}^{{commit}}") == git(repo, "rev-parse",
                                                                          "ledger")  # fmt: skip
    entries = BranchLedger(repo, crew.ledger.genesis).entries()
    assert [e["type"] for e in entries] == ["genesis", "transition"]


def test_the_factory_refuses_what_would_break_a_proof(world: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    cfg: RuntimeConfig = world["cfg"]
    other = attest.Ed25519Signer.generate()
    other.save(world["keys"] / "other", world["keys"] / "other.pub")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeConfigError, match="attest_pubkey"):
        runtime.build(RuntimeConfig(repo=cfg.repo, t0_key=world["keys"] / "other",
                                    crew_model="offline"))  # fmt: skip
    inside = cfg.repo / "attest-t0"
    inside.write_bytes(cfg.t0_key.read_bytes())
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeConfigError, match="inside a git worktree"):
        runtime.build(RuntimeConfig(repo=cfg.repo, t0_key=inside, crew_model="offline"))
    inside.unlink()
    record = json.loads((cfg.repo / WINDOW_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    closed = world["tmp"] / "closed.json"
    closed.write_text(json.dumps({**record, "t1": record["t0"]}), encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeConfigError, match="closed"):
        runtime.build(RuntimeConfig(repo=cfg.repo, t0_key=cfg.t0_key, window=closed))
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeConfigError, match="is missing"):
        runtime.build(RuntimeConfig(repo=cfg.repo, t0_key=cfg.t0_key,
                                    window=world["tmp"] / "missing.json"))  # fmt: skip
    git(cfg.repo, "update-ref", "-d", "refs/heads/ledger")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeConfigError, match="no genesis entry"):
        runtime.build(cfg)


def test_the_sabotage_lane_delivers_through_the_upstream_lane(world: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    cfg: RuntimeConfig = world["cfg"]
    secret, recipient = new_identity()
    identity = world["keys"] / "t0.agekey"
    identity.write_text(secret + "\n", encoding="ascii")
    sab = SabotageConfig(world["tmp"] / "store", identity, recipient)
    with_lane = RuntimeConfig(repo=cfg.repo, t0_key=cfg.t0_key, sabotage=sab)
    notary = Notary(world["signer"])
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeConfigError, match="GitHub"):

DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S = 120.0
_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S = 10.0


class ProcError(RuntimeError):
    """A child exited non-zero, or was killed, while the caller required success."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, result: Result) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.result = result


class ProcTimeout(ProcError):
    """A child exceeded its timeout; its whole process tree was killed."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Result:
    argv: tuple[str, ...]
    returncode: int
    stdout: str
    stderr: str
    duration_s: float
    timed_out: bool

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.returncode == 0 and not self.timed_out

    def check(self) -> Result:
        if self.timed_out:
            raise ProcTimeout(f"timed out after {self.duration_s:.1f}s: {self.argv}", self)
        if self.returncode != 0:
            tail = self.stderr.strip()[-2000:]
            raise ProcError(f"exit {self.returncode}: {self.argv}\n{tail}", self)
        return self


def build_env(
    extra: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    *,
    inherit: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Return the environment for a child: allowlisted inheritance, defaults, extras, forced."""
    source = os.environ if inherit is None else inherit
    env = {key: value for key, value in source.items() if key.upper() in ENV_ALLOWLIST}
    env.update(DEFAULT_ENV)
    for key, value in (extra or {}).items():
        forced = _forced_value(key)
        if forced is not None and value != forced:
            raise ValueError(f"{key} is forced to {forced!r} by the gateway and cannot be changed")
        env[key] = value
    env.update(FORCED_ENV)
    return env


def which(name: str) -> str | None:
    """Locate an executable on the gateway's PATH."""
    return shutil.which(name, path=build_env().get("PATH"))


class UnsafeExecutable(ProcError):
    """A batch shim would hand arguments to cmd.exe, where ``&``, ``|``, ``>`` become commands."""


_BATCH_SUFFIXES = (".cmd", ".bat")
_SHIM_TARGET = re.compile(r'"%dp0%\\([^"%]+?\.exe)"', re.IGNORECASE)


def resolve_executable(name: str) -> str:
    """The real executable behind ``name``; npm ``.cmd`` shims are followed to their ``.exe``.

    A batch file is never launched directly: Windows runs it through ``cmd.exe``, which would
    interpret metacharacters inside arguments such as an agent prompt.
    """
    if os.sep in name or (os.altsep and os.altsep in name):
        found: str | None = name
    else:
        found = which(name)
    if found is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"executable not found on PATH: {name}")
    if found.lower().endswith(_BATCH_SUFFIXES):
        target = exe_from_batch_shim(found)
        if target is None:
            raise UnsafeExecutable(
                f"{found} is a batch file and its target cannot be resolved safely",
                Result((name,), -1, "", "", 0.0, False),
            )
        return target
    return found


def exe_from_batch_shim(shim: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> str | None:
    """The ``.exe`` an npm-style shim (``"%dp0%\\…\\x.exe" %*``) launches, if it exists."""
    path = Path(shim)
    try:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except OSError:
        return None
    match = _SHIM_TARGET.search(text)
    if match is None:
        return None
    target = path.parent / match.group(1).replace("\\", os.sep)
    return str(target) if target.is_file() else None


def run(
    argv: Sequence[str | os.PathLike[str]],
    *,
    cwd: str | os.PathLike[str] | None = None,
    timeout_s: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S,
    extra_env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    input_text: str | None = None,
    check: bool = False,
) -> Result:
    """Run a command to completion and capture its output."""
    args = _normalise_argv(argv)
    flags, new_session = _group_flags()
    started = time.monotonic()
    # Binary pipes: text mode would rewrite "\n" as "\r\n" on Windows stdin, corrupting
    # `git commit -F -` messages and `git mktree` input. stdin goes out as exact UTF-8 bytes.
    popen = subprocess.Popen(
        args,
        cwd=cwd,
        env=build_env(extra_env),
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE if input_text is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        creationflags=flags,
        start_new_session=new_session,
    )
    payload = input_text.encode("utf-8") if input_text is not None else None
    timed_out = False
    try:
        out, err = popen.communicate(input=payload, timeout=timeout_s)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        kill_tree(popen.pid)
        try:
            out, err = popen.communicate(timeout=_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:  # a descendant escaped the group and holds a pipe
            popen.kill()
            out, err = b"", b"output not drained: a descendant held the pipe open"
    returncode = popen.returncode if popen.returncode is not None else -9
    result = Result(
        argv=tuple(args),
        returncode=returncode,
        stdout=_decode(out),
        stderr=_decode(err),
        duration_s=time.monotonic() - started,
        timed_out=timed_out,
    )
    return result.check() if check else result


def _decode(data: bytes | None) -> str:
    """UTF-8 text with universal newlines, as text-mode pipes would have produced."""
    return (data or b"").decode("utf-8", errors="replace").replace("\r\n", "\n")

"""Wiring for ``kintsugi control``: the supervisor, the queue forwarder, the Watchdog, T8 export.

State lives under ``.state/control/`` and ``.state/watchdog/`` (gitignored): the step ledger, the
attempt log, the chaos token (256-bit, never printed), the heartbeat and the pages.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import os
import secrets
import sys
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control import watchdog as w
from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW, SENSES, SURGEON

CONTROL_DIR = Path(".state") / "control"
WATCHDOG_DIR = Path(".state") / "watchdog"


async def export_history(
    target: str, workflow_id: str, out: Path, run_id: str | None = None
) -> int:
    """T8: the server's own event history of a workflow, as JSON (``temporal workflow show``)."""
    from temporalio.client import Client

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    history = await client.get_workflow_handle(workflow_id, run_id=run_id).fetch_history()
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(history.to_json(), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return len(history.events)


async def start_supervisor(target: str, config: c.ControlConfig) -> str:
    from temporalio.client import Client
    from temporalio.exceptions import WorkflowAlreadyStartedError

    from kintsugi.control.workflows import FleetSupervisor

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    try:
        handle = await client.start_workflow(FleetSupervisor.run, args=[config, None],
                                             id=config.supervisor_id, task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip
        return f"started {handle.id} run {handle.result_run_id}"
    except WorkflowAlreadyStartedError:
        return f"{config.supervisor_id} is already running"


async def forward(target: str, store_path: Path, supervisor_id: str, *, once: bool) -> int:
    from temporalio.client import Client

    from kintsugi.control.hits import Forwarder, supervisor_deliver
    from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    forwarder = Forwarder(SenseStore(store_path), supervisor_deliver(client, supervisor_id))
    if once:
        return await forwarder.drain()
    stop = threading.Event()
    with contextlib.suppress(KeyboardInterrupt, asyncio.CancelledError):
        await forwarder.run(stop)
    return forwarder.delivered


def chaos_token(repo: Path) -> str:
    path = repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "chaos.token"
    if path.is_file():
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    path.write_text(token, encoding="utf-8")
    with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
        path.chmod(0o600)
    return token

def build_watchdog(repo: Path, target: str, crew: str, *, ingress_admin: str | None,
                   admin_token: str | None, env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
                   ) -> w.Watchdog:  # fmt: skip
    """The standard pools: crew + senses in one process, the Surgeons in their own (§6.6)."""
    from kintsugi.senses.service import STORE_PATH
    from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore

    pager = w.Pager(repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "pages.jsonl")
    supervisor = w.Supervisor(pager)
    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "kintsugi.control.worker", "--target", target, "--crew", crew,
            "--ledger", str(repo / CONTROL_DIR / "steps.sqlite")]  # fmt: skip
    extra = pool_env(os.environ if env is None else env)
    supervisor.add(w.Pool("crew", [*base, "--pool", "crew", "--pool", "senses"], extra_env=extra,
                          log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "crew.log"))  # fmt: skip
    supervisor.add(w.Pool("surgeon", [*base, "--pool", "surgeon"], extra_env=extra,
                          log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "surgeon.log"))  # fmt: skip
    checks = {
        "temporal-pollers": w.temporal_pollers_check(target, [CREW, SURGEON, SENSES]),
        "senses-queue": w.queue_check(SenseStore(repo / STORE_PATH)),
        "entire-graph": w.command_check(["entire", "graph", "doctor", "--json"]),
        "neatlogs-sdk": w.command_check(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "neatlogs", "doctor", "--local", "--json"]
        ),
    }
    toggle = w.http_toggle(ingress_admin, admin_token) if ingress_admin and admin_token else None
    return w.Watchdog(
        supervisor,
        pager,
        checks,
        heartbeat_path=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "heartbeat",
        ingress_toggle=toggle,
        chaos_log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "chaos.jsonl",
    )


def run_watchdog(dog: w.Watchdog, token: str, *, port: int) -> None:
    import uvicorn

    stop = threading.Event()
    threading.Thread(target=dog.loop, args=(stop,), daemon=True).start()
    try:
        uvicorn.run(w.chaos_app(dog, token), host="127.0.0.1", port=port, log_level="warning")
    finally:
        stop.set()
        dog.supervisor.stop()

import contextlib
import os
import secrets
import sys
import threading

from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW, SENSES, SURGEON

WATCHDOG_DIR = Path(".state") / "watchdog"


async def export_history(

    """T8: the server's own event history of a workflow, as JSON (``temporal workflow show``)."""

    out.write_text(history.to_json(), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

async def start_supervisor(target: str, config: c.ControlConfig) -> str:
    from temporalio.client import Client
    from temporalio.exceptions import WorkflowAlreadyStartedError

    from kintsugi.control.workflows import FleetSupervisor

    client = await Client.connect(target)

                                             id=config.supervisor_id, task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip

    FleetSupervisor, which forwards it to every open Incident (``drift_signal``). A poll that
    fails (a fetch without network, a signal the server refused) is retried on the next tick

        ),

    toggle = w.http_toggle(ingress_admin, admin_token) if ingress_admin and admin_token else None

        pager,
        checks,

        chaos_log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "chaos.jsonl",

    import uvicorn

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# KINTSUGI-Omega runtime for the autonomy window W, inside WSL2 Ubuntu (ruling D2, Stage 13a).
#
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh check    prerequisites and the runtime file, nothing started
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh up       Temporal dev server, Watchdog (crew + Surgeon pools), supervisor,
#                                 hit forwarder, ingress, poller, fleet; AuditAnchor at T0
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh status   what is running
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh down     fleet down, then everything else in reverse order
#
# Run it from the repository's WSL path (e.g. /mnt/c/myspace/hacckathons/kintsugi-omega-master).
# It installs nothing: `check` names what is missing. It is never started from inside the Claude
# desktop app (plan §2e.5). Keep the Windows host awake for the whole of W with
# scripts/keep-awake.ps1, run in a Windows terminal beside it.
#
# Environment:
#   KINTSUGI_RUNTIME   the runtime file (JSON, outside the repository; kintsugi/crew/runtime.py)
#   KINTSUGI_ENV_FILE  optional env file with NEATLOGS_* credentials (default: .env)
#   TEMPORAL_PORT      default 7233
#   INGRESS_PORT       default 8787
#   CHAOS_PORT         default 8790
set -euo pipefail

REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
STATE="$REPO/.state/runtime"
LOGS="$STATE/logs"
PIDS="$STATE/pids"
TEMPORAL_PORT="${TEMPORAL_PORT:-7233}"
INGRESS_PORT="${INGRESS_PORT:-8787}"
CHAOS_PORT="${CHAOS_PORT:-8790}"
TARGET="127.0.0.1:${TEMPORAL_PORT}"
# A Linux virtualenv beside the Windows .venv would fight over the same directory.
export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-$HOME/.venvs/kintsugi-omega-master}"
export ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

# The processes, in start order. `down` stops them in reverse.
SERVICES=(temporal watchdog forward ingress poller fleet)

say() { printf '[w-runtime] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { say "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

load_env() {
  local file="${KINTSUGI_ENV_FILE:-$REPO/.env}"
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    set -a
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    . "$file"
    set +a
  fi
}

need() {
  local missing=()
  for tool in "$@"; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$tool"); done
  ((${#missing[@]} == 0)) || die "missing: ${missing[*]} (install them in WSL first)"
}

check() {
  need git uv entire gh temporal docker
  [[ "$(uname -s)" == "Linux" ]] || die "run inside WSL2 Ubuntu (ruling D2)"
  docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "the Docker engine in WSL is not running"
  docker info 2>/dev/null | grep -q runsc || say "warning: gVisor (runsc) is not registered with Docker"
  [[ -n "${KINTSUGI_RUNTIME:-}" ]] || die "KINTSUGI_RUNTIME must name the runtime file"
  [[ -f "$KINTSUGI_RUNTIME" ]] || die "$KINTSUGI_RUNTIME does not exist"
  case "$(realpath "$KINTSUGI_RUNTIME")" in
    "$REPO"/*) die "the runtime file must live outside the repository" ;;
  esac
  [[ -f "$REPO/.kintsugi/window.json" ]] || die "no window record: W starts with 'kintsugi t0 genesis'"
  [[ "$(git -C "$REPO" remote get-url origin)" == *"/kintsugi-omega-master.git" ]] \
    || die "origin is not the Master Edition repository"
  (cd "$REPO" && uv sync --frozen --quiet)
  (cd "$REPO" && uv run python -m kintsugi.crew.runtime check)
}

pid_of() { [[ -f "$PIDS/$1" ]] && cat "$PIDS/$1"; }
alive() { local pid; pid="$(pid_of "$1")" && [[ -n "$pid" ]] && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; }

spawn() {  # spawn NAME COMMAND... : detached, logged, pid recorded
  local name="$1"; shift
  if alive "$name"; then say "$name already running (pid $(pid_of "$name"))"; return; fi
  (cd "$REPO" && setsid nohup "$@" >>"$LOGS/$name.log" 2>&1 & echo $! >"$PIDS/$name")
  say "$name started (pid $(pid_of "$name"), log $LOGS/$name.log)"
}

wait_port() {
  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
    (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$1") 2>/dev/null && return 0
    sleep 1
  done
  die "nothing listens on port $1"
}

up() {
  load_env
  check
  mkdir -p "$LOGS" "$PIDS"
  spawn temporal temporal server start-dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port "$TEMPORAL_PORT" --headless \
    --db-filename "$STATE/temporal.sqlite"
  wait_port "$TEMPORAL_PORT"
  spawn watchdog uv run kintsugi control watchdog --target "$TARGET" \
    --crew kintsugi.crew.runtime:crew --chaos-port "$CHAOS_PORT" \
    --ingress-admin "http://127.0.0.1:${INGRESS_PORT}/admin/availability"
  (cd "$REPO" && uv run kintsugi control supervisor --target "$TARGET")
  (cd "$REPO" && uv run python -m kintsugi.crew.runtime start-anchors --target "$TARGET")
  spawn forward uv run kintsugi control forward --target "$TARGET"
  spawn ingress uv run kintsugi senses ingress --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$INGRESS_PORT"
  spawn poller uv run kintsugi senses poll
  spawn fleet uv run kintsugi fleet up
  say "up. Public ingress: point the tunnel (cloudflared) at 127.0.0.1:${INGRESS_PORT}, then"
  say "run 'kintsugi senses provision --public-url <tunnel>'. Anchor post texts: .state/anchors/."
}

status() {
  for name in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
    if alive "$name"; then say "$name: running (pid $(pid_of "$name"))"; else say "$name: stopped"; fi
  done
}

down() {
  if alive fleet; then (cd "$REPO" && uv run kintsugi fleet down) || true; fi
  for ((i = ${#SERVICES[@]} - 1; i >= 0; i--)); do
    local name="${SERVICES[i]}"
    if alive "$name"; then
      kill -TERM -- "-$(pid_of "$name")" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$(pid_of "$name")" || true
      say "$name stopped"
    fi
    rm -f "$PIDS/$name"
  done
}

case "${1:-}" in
  check) load_env; check ;;
  up) up ;;
  status) status ;;
  down) down ;;
  *) die "usage: $0 {check|up|status|down}" ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# KINTSUGI-Omega runtime for the autonomy window W, inside WSL2 Ubuntu (ruling D2, Stage 13a).
#
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh check    prerequisites and the runtime file, nothing started
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh up       Temporal dev server, Watchdog (crew + Surgeon pools), supervisor,
#                                 hit forwarder, main watcher (L4 drift from origin/main), ingress,
#                                 poller, fleet; AuditAnchor at T0
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh status   what is running
#   scripts/w-runtime.sh down     fleet down, then everything else in reverse order
#
# Run it from the repository's WSL path (e.g. /mnt/c/myspace/hacckathons/kintsugi-omega-master).
# It installs nothing: `check` names what is missing. It is never started from inside the Claude
# desktop app (plan §2e.5). Keep the Windows host awake for the whole of W with
# scripts/keep-awake.ps1, run in a Windows terminal beside it.
#
# Environment:
#   KINTSUGI_RUNTIME   the runtime file (JSON, outside the repository; kintsugi/crew/runtime.py)
#   KINTSUGI_ENV_FILE  optional env file with NEATLOGS_* credentials (default: .env)
#   TEMPORAL_PORT      default 7233
#   INGRESS_PORT       default 8787
#   CHAOS_PORT         default 8790
set -euo pipefail

REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
STATE="$REPO/.state/runtime"
LOGS="$STATE/logs"
PIDS="$STATE/pids"
TEMPORAL_PORT="${TEMPORAL_PORT:-7233}"
INGRESS_PORT="${INGRESS_PORT:-8787}"
CHAOS_PORT="${CHAOS_PORT:-8790}"
TARGET="127.0.0.1:${TEMPORAL_PORT}"
# A Linux virtualenv beside the Windows .venv would fight over the same directory.
export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-$HOME/.venvs/kintsugi-omega-master}"
export ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

# The processes, in start order. `down` stops them in reverse.
SERVICES=(temporal watchdog forward watch-main ingress poller fleet)

say() { printf '[w-runtime] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { say "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

load_env() {
  local file="${KINTSUGI_ENV_FILE:-$REPO/.env}"
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    set -a
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    . "$file"
    set +a
  fi
}

need() {
  local missing=()
  for tool in "$@"; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$tool"); done
  ((${#missing[@]} == 0)) || die "missing: ${missing[*]} (install them in WSL first)"
}

check() {
  need git uv entire gh temporal docker
  [[ "$(uname -s)" == "Linux" ]] || die "run inside WSL2 Ubuntu (ruling D2)"
  docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "the Docker engine in WSL is not running"
  docker info 2>/dev/null | grep -q runsc || say "warning: gVisor (runsc) is not registered with Docker"
  [[ -n "${KINTSUGI_RUNTIME:-}" ]] || die "KINTSUGI_RUNTIME must name the runtime file"
  [[ -f "$KINTSUGI_RUNTIME" ]] || die "$KINTSUGI_RUNTIME does not exist"
  case "$(realpath "$KINTSUGI_RUNTIME")" in
    "$REPO"/*) die "the runtime file must live outside the repository" ;;
  esac
  [[ -f "$REPO/.kintsugi/window.json" ]] || die "no window record: W starts with 'kintsugi t0 genesis'"
  [[ "$(git -C "$REPO" remote get-url origin)" == *"/kintsugi-omega-master.git" ]] \
    || die "origin is not the Master Edition repository"
  (cd "$REPO" && uv sync --frozen --quiet)

}

pid_of() { [[ -f "$PIDS/$1" ]] && cat "$PIDS/$1"; }
alive() { local pid; pid="$(pid_of "$1")" && [[ -n "$pid" ]] && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; }

spawn() {  # spawn NAME COMMAND... : detached, logged, pid recorded
  local name="$1"; shift
  if alive "$name"; then say "$name already running (pid $(pid_of "$name"))"; return; fi
  (cd "$REPO" && setsid nohup "$@" >>"$LOGS/$name.log" 2>&1 & echo $! >"$PIDS/$name")
  say "$name started (pid $(pid_of "$name"), log $LOGS/$name.log)"
}

  say "run 'kintsugi senses provision --public-url <tunnel>'. Anchor post texts: .state/anchors/."
}

status() {

down() {

    local name="${SERVICES[i]}"

      say "$name stopped"
    fi
    rm -f "$PIDS/$name"
  done
}

"""A scripted crew and a time-skipping Temporal harness for the control-plane tests."""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from temporalio.client import Client
from temporalio.testing import WorkflowEnvironment
from temporalio.worker import Worker

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW, SENSES, SURGEON, OmegaActivities, ScriptedCrew
from kintsugi.control.workflows import WORKFLOWS

FAST = c.ControlConfig(canary_interval_s=60.0, canary_max_batches=6, anchor_interval_s=3600.0)


@dataclass
class Scenario:
    """The environment's answers. ``passing[pass_no]`` = the round whose H-odd card passes."""

    repro_ok: bool = True
    suspect: bool = True
    budget_usd: float = 12.40
    passing: dict[int, int | None] = field(default_factory=lambda: {0: 0})
    budget_exhausted_after: int | None = None
    g7_ok: bool = True
    merged: bool = True
    canary: dict[int, str] = field(default_factory=dict)  # pass → "accept" | "reject"
    revert_ok: bool = True
    antibody: bool = False
    bad_winner: bool = False  # the coordinator names a hypothesis that failed its gates
    gate: threading.Event | None = None  # surgeon waits on it (lets a test signal mid-round)
    route: str = "open"


def crew_for(s: Scenario) -> ScriptedCrew:
    def triage(alert: c.Alert) -> c.Signature:
        return c.Signature(alert.incident_id, alert.host, "phi-" + alert.host, ("trace-1",))

    def cards(sig, cause, plan, rnd, history, prior):
        base = sig.pass_no * 10 + rnd * 2
        return [c.Card(sig.incident_id, f"H{base + n}", rnd, f"brief {n} {prior}", "base")
                for n in (1, 2)]  # fmt: skip

    def surgeon(card: c.Card) -> c.SurgeonOutcome:
        if s.gate is not None:
            s.gate.wait(timeout=30)
        return c.SurgeonOutcome(card.incident_id, card.hypothesis, 1,
                                f"kintsugi/{card.incident_id}/{card.hypothesis}",
                                f"nonce-{card.hypothesis}", f"sha-{card.hypothesis}",
                                diff_sha=f"diff-{card.hypothesis}")  # fmt: skip

    def gates(out: c.SurgeonOutcome) -> c.GateVerdict:
        number = int(out.hypothesis[1:])
        pass_no, rest = divmod(number - 1, 10)
        rnd, slot = divmod(rest, 2)
        passed = s.passing.get(pass_no) == rnd and slot == 0
        return c.GateVerdict(out.hypothesis, passed, {"G0": True, "G3": passed}, out.diff_sha)

    def coordinate(sig, rnd, verdicts: list[c.GateVerdict]) -> c.Decision:
        if s.bad_winner:
            return c.Decision(rnd, winner=verdicts[-1].hypothesis)
        winner = next((v.hypothesis for v in verdicts if v.passed), None)
        return c.Decision(rnd, winner=winner)

    canary_pass = {"n": 0}

    def canary(shipment: c.Shipment, batch: int) -> list[bool]:
        if batch == 0:
            canary_pass["n"] += 1
        mode = s.canary.get(canary_pass["n"] - 1, "accept")
        return [True] * 12 if mode == "reject" else [False] * 40

    def route(hit: c.Hit, open_incidents: list[str]) -> c.RouteDecision:
        incident = f"INC-{hit.receptor}-{hit.host}"
        if s.route == "drop":
            return c.RouteDecision("drop")
        if incident in open_incidents:
            return c.RouteDecision("attach", incident)
        return c.RouteDecision("open", incident)

    answers: dict[str, Any] = {
        "route_hit": route,
        "record_transition": lambda record: None,
        "triage": triage,
        "tag_traces": lambda inc, ids, phase: len(ids),
        "match_antibody": lambda sig: c.AntibodyMatch("AB-7", "1.1", "recipe") if s.antibody
        else None,
        "reproduce": lambda sig: c.Repro(s.repro_ok, "cassette" if s.repro_ok else None,
                                         3 if s.repro_ok else 0, 3),
        "park": lambda sig, reason: None,
        "attribute": lambda sig, repro: c.Cause(("run_reconcile",) if s.suspect else ()),
        "plan_budget": lambda sig, cause: c.BudgetPlan(s.budget_usd, 2, 3, "Team",
                                                       f"plan-{sig.incident_id}-{sig.pass_no}"),
        "fixes_prior": lambda sig: None,
        "hypothesize": cards,
        "surgeon": surgeon,
        "audit_gates": gates,
        "coordinate": coordinate,
        "dispute_experiment": lambda inc, decision: decision,
        "rewind": lambda outs: None,
        "rebase_and_rerun": lambda outs, repo, new_main: None,
        "budget_exhausted": lambda sig, plan, rnd: s.budget_exhausted_after is not None
        and rnd >= s.budget_exhausted_after,
        "escalate": lambda inc, reason: None,
        "ship": lambda out: c.Shipment(out.incident_id, out.hypothesis, out.branch,
                                       f"https://example.invalid/pr/{out.hypothesis}", s.g7_ok,
                                       s.merged, f"merge-{out.hypothesis}" if s.merged else None),
        "revert": lambda shipment: s.revert_ok,
        "quarantine_related": lambda shipment: 1,
        "synthesize_antibody": lambda out, cause: c.AntibodyRef(f"AB-{out.incident_id}", "1.0"),
        "backfill_receptor": lambda ab: None,
        "fixes_resolve": lambda sig, shipment: None,
        "ledger_append": lambda entry: "ledger-hash",
        "canary_sample": canary,
        "canary_plan": lambda shipment: c.CanaryPlan("ledger", FAST.canary_p0, FAST.canary_ratio,
                                                     "scripted: the control plane's default"),
        "apply_antibody": lambda ab, host: c.VaccinationResult(ab.antibody_id, host, True),
        "mature_antibody": lambda ab, host: c.VaccinationResult(ab.antibody_id, host, True,
                                                                "pull request opened"),
        "promote_antibody": lambda ab, host: c.AntibodyRef(ab.antibody_id, ab.version, "ACTIVE"),
        "revert_vaccination": lambda shipment: c.Shipment(
            f"REV-{shipment.incident_id}", "revert", "kintsugi/revert", "pr-revert", True, True,
            f"revert-of-{shipment.merge_sha}"),
        "refine_antibody": lambda ab, shipment: c.AntibodyRef(ab.antibody_id, "1.1", "ACTIVE"),
        "motif_scan": lambda ab: ["ledger", "scout", "triage"],
        "onboard_step": lambda host, step: c.StepResult(step, step != "O5" or host != "broken"),
        "seal_sabotage": lambda spec: f"commitment-{spec}",
        "deliver_sabotage": lambda spec: None,
        "anchor_ledger": lambda hour: f"anchor-{hour}",
    }  # fmt: skip
    return ScriptedCrew(answers)


@asynccontextmanager
async def temporal(crew: ScriptedCrew) -> AsyncIterator[tuple[WorkflowEnvironment, Client]]:
    """A time-skipping server with workers on all three task queues."""
    env = await WorkflowEnvironment.start_time_skipping()
    acts = OmegaActivities(crew, heartbeat_interval_s=0.05)
    try:
        async with (
            Worker(env.client, task_queue=CREW, workflows=list(WORKFLOWS),
                   activities=acts.activities_for(CREW)),
            Worker(env.client, task_queue=SURGEON, activities=acts.activities_for(SURGEON)),
            Worker(env.client, task_queue=SENSES, activities=acts.activities_for(SENSES)),
        ):  # fmt: skip
            yield env, env.client
    finally:
        await env.shutdown()

"""Every activity the control plane declares has a real crew handler (Stage 5's ``Crew`` port)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import SPECS, StepContext
from kintsugi.crew.factory import OmegaCrew
from kintsugi.memory.library import AntibodyLibrary
from kintsugi.onboard.desk import OnboardingCase, OnboardingDesk

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CRM = REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "rehearsal" / "crm_practice"
FORM = (REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "rehearsal" / "oss1" / "intake.md").read_text(
    encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip


def test_all_declared_activities_have_a_handler() -> None:
    missing = sorted(name for name in SPECS if not callable(getattr(OmegaCrew, f"do_{name}", None)))
    assert missing == []
    assert len(SPECS) == 38


def test_the_repairs_verdict_is_written_back_to_the_failing_traces(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile

    sent: list[tuple[str, list[str], str | None]] = []

    class Feedback:
        def verdict(self, incident: str, trace_ids: Any, *, pr_url: str | None,
                    error_class: str | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:  # fmt: skip
            sent.append((incident, list(trace_ids), pr_url))
            return [{"trace": t, "status": "sent"} for t in trace_ids]

    cases = CaseFile(tmp_path, "INC-0042")
    crew = SimpleNamespace(feedback=Feedback(), fixes=None,
                           ctx=SimpleNamespace(case=lambda incident: cases))  # fmt: skip
    sig = c.Signature("INC-0042", "ledger", "phi-1", ("trace-1", "trace-2"))
    shipment = c.Shipment("INC-0042", "H1", "kintsugi/INC-0042/H1", "https://e.invalid/pr/5",
                          True, True)  # fmt: skip
    OmegaCrew.do_fixes_resolve(crew, _ctx("fixes_resolve"), sig, shipment)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert sent == [("INC-0042", ["trace-1", "trace-2"], "https://e.invalid/pr/5")]
    stored = cases.root / "trace_feedback" / "verdict.json"
    assert stored.is_file()
    without = SimpleNamespace(feedback=None, fixes=None, ctx=None)
    assert OmegaCrew.do_fixes_resolve(without, _ctx("fixes_resolve"), sig, shipment) is None  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def _ctx(name: str) -> StepContext:
    return StepContext(name, f"{name}:key", 1, lambda *details: None)


def test_onboard_step_runs_the_desk_and_answers_without_one(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    desk = OnboardingDesk(tmp_path / "cases", AntibodyLibrary(REPO / "antibodies"))
    desk.register(OnboardingCase("crm-practice", FORM, str(CRM), package_dir="practice_crm"))
    crew = SimpleNamespace(onboarding=desk)
    first = OmegaCrew.do_onboard_step(crew, _ctx("onboard_step"), "crm-practice", "O1")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert isinstance(first, c.StepResult)
    assert first.ok and first.detail["pr_only"] is True  # noqa: PT018
    second = OmegaCrew.do_onboard_step(crew, _ctx("onboard_step"), "crm-practice", "O2")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert second.ok and second.detail["manifests"] == ["pyproject.toml"]  # noqa: PT018
    bare = SimpleNamespace(onboarding=None)
    none = OmegaCrew.do_onboard_step(bare, _ctx("onboard_step"), "crm-practice", "O1")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert not none.ok
    assert "no onboarding desk" in none.detail["error"]

"""Wiring for ``kintsugi control``: the supervisor, the queue forwarder, the Watchdog, T8 export,
and the main-branch watcher that signals L4 drift (§6.4).

State lives under ``.state/control/`` and ``.state/watchdog/`` (gitignored): the step ledger, the
attempt log, the chaos token (256-bit, never printed), the heartbeat and the pages.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import os
import secrets
import sys
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control import watchdog as w
from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW, SENSES, SURGEON

CONTROL_DIR = Path(".state") / "control"
WATCHDOG_DIR = Path(".state") / "watchdog"


async def export_history(
    target: str, workflow_id: str, out: Path, run_id: str | None = None
) -> int:
    """T8: the server's own event history of a workflow, as JSON (``temporal workflow show``)."""
    from temporalio.client import Client

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    history = await client.get_workflow_handle(workflow_id, run_id=run_id).fetch_history()
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(history.to_json(), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return len(history.events)


async def start_supervisor(target: str, config: c.ControlConfig) -> str:
    from temporalio.client import Client
    from temporalio.exceptions import WorkflowAlreadyStartedError

    from kintsugi.control.workflows import FleetSupervisor

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    try:
        handle = await client.start_workflow(FleetSupervisor.run, args=[config, None],
                                             id=config.supervisor_id, task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip
        return f"started {handle.id} run {handle.result_run_id}"
    except WorkflowAlreadyStartedError:
        return f"{config.supervisor_id} is already running"


async def forward(target: str, store_path: Path, supervisor_id: str, *, once: bool) -> int:
    from temporalio.client import Client

    from kintsugi.control.hits import Forwarder, supervisor_deliver
    from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    forwarder = Forwarder(SenseStore(store_path), supervisor_deliver(client, supervisor_id))
    if once:
        return await forwarder.drain()
    stop = threading.Event()
    with contextlib.suppress(KeyboardInterrupt, asyncio.CancelledError):
        await forwarder.run(stop)
    return forwarder.delivered


async def watch_main(
    target: str,
    repos: Mapping[str, Path],
    supervisor_id: str,
    *,
    remote: str | None = "origin",
    branch: str = "main",
    state_path: Path | None = None,
    interval_s: float = 30.0,
    once: bool = False,
    signal: Any = None,  # tests: an async (repo, new_main) callable instead of Temporal
    log: Any = print,
) -> int:
    """L4 (§6.4): poll ``<remote>/<branch>`` and signal ``drift(repo, new_main)`` into the
    FleetSupervisor, which forwards it to every open Incident (``drift_signal``). A poll that
    fails (a fetch without network, a signal the server refused) is retried on the next tick
    and the move it saw is reported again; nothing is dropped. Returns the drifts signalled."""
    from kintsugi.senses.drift import Drift, MainWatcher

    if signal is None:
        from temporalio.client import Client

        client = await Client.connect(target)
        supervisor = client.get_workflow_handle(supervisor_id)

        async def signal(repo: str, new_main: str) -> None:
            await supervisor.signal("drift", args=[repo, new_main])

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

    def on_drift(drift: Drift) -> None:  # runs in the polling thread; waits for the signal
        asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(signal(drift.repo, drift.new_main), loop).result(60)
        log(f"drift {drift.repo}: {drift.old_main[:12]} -> {drift.new_main[:12]} signalled")

    watcher = MainWatcher(repos, on_drift, branch=branch, state_path=state_path, remote=remote)
    signalled = 0
    while True:
        try:
            signalled += len(await asyncio.to_thread(watcher.poll_once))
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - the watcher keeps watching (logged)
            log(f"watch-main: poll failed, retrying: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:500])
            if once:
                raise
        if once:
            return signalled
        await asyncio.sleep(interval_s)


def chaos_token(repo: Path) -> str:
    path = repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "chaos.token"
    if path.is_file():
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    path.write_text(token, encoding="utf-8")
    with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
        path.chmod(0o600)
    return token


# What the worker pools need beyond the gateway's allowlist: the W runtime file (Stage 13a) and
# the neatlogs Public API credentials the crew reads failing traces with, and the ingest key and
# endpoint its own kintsugi:<role> traces are exported with (§4.1.2). Passed explicitly.
POOL_ENV = ("KINTSUGI_RUNTIME", "NEATLOGS_PROJECT_ID", "NEATLOGS_SERVICE_TOKEN",
            "NEATLOGS_OAUTH_TOKEN", "NEATLOGS_API_KEY", "NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT")  # fmt: skip


def pool_env(source: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {key: source[key] for key in POOL_ENV if source.get(key)}


def build_watchdog(repo: Path, target: str, crew: str, *, ingress_admin: str | None,
                   admin_token: str | None, env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
                   ) -> w.Watchdog:  # fmt: skip
    """The standard pools: crew + senses in one process, the Surgeons in their own (§6.6)."""
    from kintsugi.senses.service import STORE_PATH
    from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore

    pager = w.Pager(repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "pages.jsonl")
    supervisor = w.Supervisor(pager)
    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "kintsugi.control.worker", "--target", target, "--crew", crew,
            "--ledger", str(repo / CONTROL_DIR / "steps.sqlite")]  # fmt: skip
    extra = pool_env(os.environ if env is None else env)
    supervisor.add(w.Pool("crew", [*base, "--pool", "crew", "--pool", "senses"], extra_env=extra,
                          log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "crew.log"))  # fmt: skip
    supervisor.add(w.Pool("surgeon", [*base, "--pool", "surgeon"], extra_env=extra,
                          log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "surgeon.log"))  # fmt: skip
    checks = {
        "temporal-pollers": w.temporal_pollers_check(target, [CREW, SURGEON, SENSES]),
        "senses-queue": w.queue_check(SenseStore(repo / STORE_PATH)),
        "entire-graph": w.command_check(["entire", "graph", "doctor", "--json"]),
        "neatlogs-sdk": w.command_check(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "neatlogs", "doctor", "--local", "--json"]
        ),
    }
    toggle = w.http_toggle(ingress_admin, admin_token) if ingress_admin and admin_token else None
    return w.Watchdog(
        supervisor,
        pager,
        checks,
        heartbeat_path=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "heartbeat",
        ingress_toggle=toggle,
        chaos_log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "chaos.jsonl",
    )


def run_watchdog(dog: w.Watchdog, token: str, *, port: int) -> None:
    import uvicorn

    stop = threading.Event()
    threading.Thread(target=dog.loop, args=(stop,), daemon=True).start()
    try:
        uvicorn.run(w.chaos_app(dog, token), host="127.0.0.1", port=port, log_level="warning")
    finally:
        stop.set()
        dog.supervisor.stop()


def summary(dog: w.Watchdog) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {name: {"pid": dog.supervisor.pid(name), "starts": pool.starts, "paged": pool.paged}
            for name, pool in dog.supervisor.pools.items()}  # fmt: skip

"""Wiring for ``kintsugi control``: the supervisor, the queue forwarder, the Watchdog, T8 export,
and the main-branch watcher that signals L4 drift (§6.4).

State lives under ``.state/control/`` and ``.state/watchdog/`` (gitignored): the step ledger, the
attempt log, the chaos token (256-bit, never printed), the heartbeat and the pages.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import os
import secrets
import sys
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control import watchdog as w
from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW, SENSES, SURGEON

CONTROL_DIR = Path(".state") / "control"
WATCHDOG_DIR = Path(".state") / "watchdog"


async def export_history(
    target: str, workflow_id: str, out: Path, run_id: str | None = None
) -> int:
    """T8: the server's own event history of a workflow, as JSON (``temporal workflow show``)."""
    from temporalio.client import Client

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    history = await client.get_workflow_handle(workflow_id, run_id=run_id).fetch_history()
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(history.to_json(), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return len(history.events)


async def start_supervisor(target: str, config: c.ControlConfig) -> str:
    from temporalio.client import Client
    from temporalio.exceptions import WorkflowAlreadyStartedError

    from kintsugi.control.workflows import FleetSupervisor

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    try:
        handle = await client.start_workflow(FleetSupervisor.run, args=[config, None],
                                             id=config.supervisor_id, task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip
        return f"started {handle.id} run {handle.result_run_id}"
    except WorkflowAlreadyStartedError:
        return f"{config.supervisor_id} is already running"


async def forward(target: str, store_path: Path, supervisor_id: str, *, once: bool) -> int:
    from temporalio.client import Client

    from kintsugi.control.hits import Forwarder, supervisor_deliver
    from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore

    client = await Client.connect(target)
    forwarder = Forwarder(SenseStore(store_path), supervisor_deliver(client, supervisor_id))
    if once:
        return await forwarder.drain()
    stop = threading.Event()
    with contextlib.suppress(KeyboardInterrupt, asyncio.CancelledError):
        await forwarder.run(stop)
    return forwarder.delivered


async def watch_main(
    target: str,
    repos: Mapping[str, Path],
    supervisor_id: str,
    *,
    remote: str | None = "origin",
    branch: str = "main",
    state_path: Path | None = None,
    interval_s: float = 30.0,
    once: bool = False,
    signal: Any = None,  # tests: an async (repo, new_main) callable instead of Temporal
    log: Any = print,
) -> int:
    """L4 (§6.4): poll ``<remote>/<branch>`` and signal ``drift(repo, new_main)`` into the
    FleetSupervisor, which forwards it to every open Incident (``drift_signal``). A poll that
    fails (a fetch without network, a signal the server refused) is retried on the next tick
    and the move it saw is reported again; nothing is dropped. Returns the drifts signalled."""
    from kintsugi.senses.drift import Drift, MainWatcher

    if signal is None:
        from temporalio.client import Client

        client = await Client.connect(target)
        supervisor = client.get_workflow_handle(supervisor_id)

        async def signal(repo: str, new_main: str) -> None:
            await supervisor.signal("drift", args=[repo, new_main])

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

    def on_drift(drift: Drift) -> None:  # runs in the polling thread; waits for the signal
        asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(signal(drift.repo, drift.new_main), loop).result(60)
        log(f"drift {drift.repo}: {drift.old_main[:12]} -> {drift.new_main[:12]} signalled")

    watcher = MainWatcher(repos, on_drift, branch=branch, state_path=state_path, remote=remote)
    signalled = 0
    while True:
        try:
            signalled += len(await asyncio.to_thread(watcher.poll_once))
        except Exception as error:  # the watcher keeps watching (logged)
            log(f"watch-main: poll failed, retrying: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:500])
            if once:
                raise
        if once:
            return signalled
        await asyncio.sleep(interval_s)


def chaos_token(repo: Path) -> str:
    path = repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "chaos.token"
    if path.is_file():
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    path.write_text(token, encoding="utf-8")
    with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
        path.chmod(0o600)
    return token


# What the worker pools need beyond the gateway's allowlist: the W runtime file (Stage 13a) and
# the neatlogs Public API credentials the crew reads failing traces with, and the ingest key and
# endpoint its own kintsugi:<role> traces are exported with (§4.1.2). Passed explicitly.
POOL_ENV = ("KINTSUGI_RUNTIME", "NEATLOGS_PROJECT_ID", "NEATLOGS_SERVICE_TOKEN",
            "NEATLOGS_OAUTH_TOKEN", "NEATLOGS_API_KEY", "NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT")  # fmt: skip


def pool_env(source: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {key: source[key] for key in POOL_ENV if source.get(key)}


def build_watchdog(repo: Path, target: str, crew: str, *, ingress_admin: str | None,
                   admin_token: str | None, env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
                   ) -> w.Watchdog:  # fmt: skip
    """The standard pools: crew + senses in one process, the Surgeons in their own (§6.6)."""
    from kintsugi.senses.service import STORE_PATH
    from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore

    pager = w.Pager(repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "pages.jsonl")
    supervisor = w.Supervisor(pager)
    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "kintsugi.control.worker", "--target", target, "--crew", crew,
            "--ledger", str(repo / CONTROL_DIR / "steps.sqlite")]  # fmt: skip
    extra = pool_env(os.environ if env is None else env)
    supervisor.add(w.Pool("crew", [*base, "--pool", "crew", "--pool", "senses"], extra_env=extra,
                          log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "crew.log"))  # fmt: skip
    supervisor.add(w.Pool("surgeon", [*base, "--pool", "surgeon"], extra_env=extra,
                          log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "surgeon.log"))  # fmt: skip
    checks = {
        "temporal-pollers": w.temporal_pollers_check(target, [CREW, SURGEON, SENSES]),
        "senses-queue": w.queue_check(SenseStore(repo / STORE_PATH)),
        "entire-graph": w.command_check(["entire", "graph", "doctor", "--json"]),
        "neatlogs-sdk": w.command_check(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "neatlogs", "doctor", "--local", "--json"]
        ),
    }
    toggle = w.http_toggle(ingress_admin, admin_token) if ingress_admin and admin_token else None
    return w.Watchdog(
        supervisor,
        pager,
        checks,
        heartbeat_path=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "heartbeat",
        ingress_toggle=toggle,
        chaos_log=repo / WATCHDOG_DIR / "chaos.jsonl",
    )


def run_watchdog(dog: w.Watchdog, token: str, *, port: int) -> None:
    import uvicorn

    stop = threading.Event()
    threading.Thread(target=dog.loop, args=(stop,), daemon=True).start()
    try:
        uvicorn.run(w.chaos_app(dog, token), host="127.0.0.1", port=port, log_level="warning")
    finally:
        stop.set()
        dog.supervisor.stop()


def summary(dog: w.Watchdog) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {name: {"pid": dog.supervisor.pid(name), "starts": pool.starts, "paged": pool.paged}
            for name, pool in dog.supervisor.pools.items()}  # fmt: skip

"""Workflows on a time-skipping Temporal test server (spec §5.3, §5.13; plan Stage 5).

Every Incident ends RESOLVED, ESCALATED or PARKED and its transition log folds legally (I3);
nothing ships without a G0–G6 winner (I1); a canary rejection re-enters within its bound; a
drift signal mid-round triggers the L4 rebase; the supervisor's signals, queries, concurrency
limit and continue_as_new hold; and every recorded history replays deterministically.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import threading
import time
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

import pytest
from temporalio import workflow
from temporalio.client import Client, WorkflowFailureError, WorkflowHistory
from temporalio.service import RPCError
from temporalio.worker import Replayer, UnsandboxedWorkflowRunner

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW
from kintsugi.control.states import IncidentState, fold
from kintsugi.control.workflows import (
    WORKFLOWS,
    AuditAnchor,
    Campaign,
    Canary,
    CrossHostMaturation,
    FleetSupervisor,
    Incident,
    Onboarding,
    SabotageCampaign,
    VaccinationWave,
)
from kintsugi.stats.sprt import SPRT
from tests.helpers.control import FAST, Scenario, crew_for, temporal

ALERT = c.Alert("INC-0042", "ledger", (c.Hit("k1", "d", "t", "s", receptor="R-007"),))


def run(coro: Any) -> Any:
    return asyncio.run(coro)


async def incident(scenario: Scenario, config: c.ControlConfig = FAST, alert: c.Alert = ALERT):
    crew = crew_for(scenario)
    async with temporal(crew) as (_env, client):
        handle = await client.start_workflow(
            Incident.run, args=[alert, config], id=alert.incident_id, task_queue=CREW
        )
        outcome: c.Outcome = await handle.result()
        history = await handle.fetch_history()
    return outcome, crew, history


def legal(outcome: c.Outcome) -> IncidentState:
    events = [(IncidentState(t.source), IncidentState(t.target), t.outcome)
              for t in outcome.transitions]  # fmt: skip
    return fold(events)


def test_a_repaired_incident_resolves_through_every_stage() -> None:
    outcome, crew, _ = run(incident(Scenario()))
    assert outcome.state == "RESOLVED"
    assert legal(outcome) is IncidentState.RESOLVED
    assert [t.target for t in outcome.transitions] == ["REPRODUCED", "ATTRIBUTED", "REPAIRING",
                                                      "SHIPPED", "CANARY", "RESOLVED"]  # fmt: skip
    names = [name for name, _ in crew.calls]
    assert names.index("ship") > max(i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == "audit_gates")  # I1
    assert crew.count("ship") == 1
    assert crew.count("surgeon") == 2  # K = 2 parallel Surgeons
    assert outcome.shipment is not None
    assert outcome.shipment.hypothesis == "H1"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("scenario", "state", "last"),


def test_a_failed_delivery_never_stops_the_sealed_schedule() -> None:
    """An Arena request that cannot be delivered (refused, or out of retries) is recorded and

"""§7.4 / E.3: an incident closes with ``evidence/<INC>/bundle.json``; its digest is on the ledger.

The crew assembles the bundle from its case file, ledger and telemetry journal; the ``Incident``
workflow hands it the facts only it holds and writes ``bundle_sha256`` into the closing ledger
entry (E.2); audit C1 accepts the bundle on disk and rejects a tampered one.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW, StepContext
from kintsugi.control.workflows import Incident
from kintsugi.crew import bundler
from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.crew.factory import OmegaCrew
from kintsugi.proof import attest, audit, schemas
from kintsugi.proof.anchor import sign_anchor, tag_name
from kintsugi.proof.audit import Status
from kintsugi.proof.bundle import file_sha256, read_bundle, verify_attachments
from kintsugi.proof.ledger import Ledger, genesis_hash
from tests.helpers.control import FAST, Scenario, crew_for, temporal

INC = "INC-0042"
T0 = datetime(2026, 10, 12, 13, 20, tzinfo=UTC)


def _case(root: Path) -> CaseFile:
    """A case file as the roles leave it after a repair that shipped (aggregates only)."""
    case = CaseFile(root, INC)
    case.put("repro", "g0", {"ok": True, "cassette_sha": "sha256:" + "c" * 64, "failing": ["t1"],
                             "attempts": [{"evidence": {"replays_failing": 3}}]},
             by="pathologist")  # fmt: skip
    case.put("cassette", "g0", {"sha256": "sha256:" + "c" * 64, "interactions": 4},
             by="pathologist")  # fmt: skip
    case.put("intent_record", "record", {"suspects": ["run_reconcile"], "checkpoint": "ck_7f3a",
                                         "commit": "abc123", "quotes": ["retry keeps state"]},
             by="archivist")  # fmt: skip
    case.put("cause", "report", {"suspects": ["run_reconcile", "ReconcileSession.__init__"],
                                 "first_bad_checkpoint": "ck_7f3a"}, by="archivist")  # fmt: skip
    case.put("graph_context", "search", {"query": "duplicate journal entries"}, by="archivist")
    case.put("plan", "plan", {"budget_usd": 12.4, "plan_sha": "sha256:" + "p" * 64},
             by="governor")  # fmt: skip
    for hyp, passed in (("H1", True), ("H2", False)):
        case.put("card", hyp, {"round": 0, "host": "ledger", "title": hyp}, by="coordinator")
        case.put("outcome", hyp, {"commit": f"sha-{hyp}", "checkpoint": f"ck_{hyp}"},
                 by="surgeon")  # fmt: skip
        gates = {"G0": {"status": "pass"}, "G4": {"status": "pass" if passed else "fail"}}
        case.put("verdict", hyp, {"gates": gates, "passed": passed,
                                  "g4": {"b": 26, "c": 1, "p": 2.1e-7}}, by="auditor")  # fmt: skip
    case.put("reverify", "H1", {"G3": "rerun:7", "G4": "rerun:intersection{run_reconcile}",
                                "new_main": "f00"}, by="auditor")  # fmt: skip
    case.add_cost("surgeon", 6.5, "H1 session")
    case.add_cost("surgeon", 2.84, "H2 session")
    case.add_cost("archivist", 0.5, "intent record")
    return case


def _closing(state: str = "RESOLVED") -> dict[str, Any]:
    shipment = c.Shipment(INC, "H1", f"kintsugi/{INC}/H1", "https://github.com/o/r/pull/13",
                          True, True, "merge-H1")  # fmt: skip
    winner = c.SurgeonOutcome(INC, "H1", 1, f"kintsugi/{INC}/H1", "nonce", "sha-H1", "ck_H1")
    from dataclasses import asdict

    return {"incident": INC, "host": "ledger", "state": state, "reason": "canary accepted",
            "pass": 0, "transitions": ["OPEN->REPRODUCED", "CANARY->RESOLVED"],
            "traces": {"failing": ["trace-aa", "local:obs-1"], "after": ["trace-bb"]},
            "canary": {"accepted": True, "rejected": False, "n": 46, "llr": -2.3},
            "winner": asdict(winner), "shipment": asdict(shipment),
            "antibody": "AB-17@1.0"}  # fmt: skip


def _crew(tmp_path: Path) -> OmegaCrew:
    ctx = CrewContext(state=tmp_path / "crew", targets={})
    return OmegaCrew(ctx, runner=lambda: None,  # type: ignore[arg-type,return-value]
                     evidence_root=tmp_path / "evidence")  # fmt: skip


def _step() -> StepContext:
    return StepContext("emit_bundle", "emit_bundle:key", 1, lambda *details: None)


def test_the_bundle_is_written_in_the_e3_shape_with_its_attachments(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    crew = _crew(tmp_path)
    _case(crew.ctx.state / "cases")
    crew.ledger.append({"type": "transition", "incident": INC})
    ref = crew.do_emit_bundle(_step(), _closing())
    path = tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "bundle.json"
    assert Path(ref.path) == path
    bundle, on_disk = read_bundle(path.parent)
    assert ref.sha256 == on_disk == file_sha256(path)  # canonical bytes: file digest = digest
    data = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    assert schemas.errors("E3", data) == []
    assert data["incident"] == INC and data["host"] == "ledger"
    assert data["traces"] == {"failing": ["trace-aa"], "before": ["trace-aa"],
                              "after": ["trace-bb"]}  # fmt: skip
    assert data["local_traces"] == ["local:obs-1"]  # never offered to C8 as a neatlogs id
    assert data["cassette"] == {"g0": "3/3 fail", "path": "case/cassette/g0.json",
                                "sha256": "sha256:" + "c" * 64}  # fmt: skip
    assert data["cause"]["suspects"] == ["run_reconcile", "ReconcileSession.__init__"]
    assert data["cause"]["first_bad_checkpoint"] == "ck_7f3a"
    assert data["cause"]["intent_record"]["quotes"] == ["retry keeps state"]
    [rnd] = data["rounds"]
    assert [(h["id"], h["checkpoint"], h["passed"]) for h in rnd["hyps"]] == [
        ("H1", "ck_H1", True), ("H2", "ck_H2", False)]  # fmt: skip
    assert data["winner"] == {"hyp": "H1", "commit": "sha-H1", "checkpoint": "ck_H1",
                              "stats": {"b": 26, "c": 1, "p": 2.1e-7}}  # fmt: skip
    assert data["reverify"] == {"G3": "rerun:7", "G4": "rerun:intersection{run_reconcile}"}
    assert data["ship"]["pr"] == "https://github.com/o/r/pull/13"
    assert data["canary"]["decision"] == "accept" and data["canary"]["n"] == 46
    assert data["cost"]["total_usd"] == data["cost"]["actual_usd"] == 9.84
    assert data["cost"]["by_role"] == {"archivist": 0.5, "surgeon": 9.34}
    assert "sessions" not in data["cost"]  # no telemetry journal: no session is claimed
    assert data["antibody"] == "AB-17@1.0"
    assert data["checkpoints"] == ["ck_H1", "ck_H2"]
    assert data["ledger"]["entries"] == 1
    assert bundle.incident == INC
    for attached in ("case/cassette/g0.json", "case/intent_record/record.json",
                     "case/verdict/H1.json", "case/reverify/H1.json", "case/costs.jsonl"):
        assert (path.parent / attached).is_file(), attached
    assert verify_attachments(path.parent) == []


def test_an_escalated_incident_still_closes_with_a_bundle(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    crew = _crew(tmp_path)
    CaseFile(crew.ctx.state / "cases", INC).add_cost("archivist", 0.25, "attribution")
    closing = {**_closing("ESCALATED"), "winner": None, "shipment": None, "canary": None,
               "antibody": None, "reason": "rounds or budget exhausted"}  # fmt: skip
    ref = crew.do_emit_bundle(_step(), closing)
    data = json.loads(Path(ref.path).read_bytes())
    assert schemas.errors("E3", data) == []
    assert data["outcome"]["state"] == "ESCALATED"
    assert not {"winner", "ship", "canary", "antibody"} & set(data)  # never invented
    assert data["cost"]["actual_usd"] == 0.25


def test_audit_c1_checks_the_bundle_on_disk_against_the_ledger(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    crew = _crew(tmp_path)
    _case(crew.ctx.state / "cases")
    ref = crew.do_emit_bundle(_step(), _closing())
    signer = attest.Ed25519Signer.generate()
    genesis = genesis_hash(T0.isoformat(), signer.public_key_raw())
    book = Ledger(genesis)
    book.append({"type": "incident", "incident": INC, "state": "RESOLVED",
                 "at": (T0 + timedelta(minutes=9)).isoformat(),
                 "bundle_sha256": ref.sha256})  # fmt: skip
    entries = list(book.entries)
    anchors = [sign_anchor(tag_name(T0 + timedelta(minutes=30)), 1, entries[0]["hash"], signer)]
    public = attest.load_public_key(signer.public_key_openssh())
    published = audit._bundles(tmp_path / "evidence")  # what `make judge` reads, per incident
    digests = {inc: b["digest"] for inc, b in published.items()}
    assert digests == {INC: ref.sha256}
    assert audit.c1_ledger(entries, genesis, anchors, public, digests).status is Status.PASS
    path = Path(ref.path)
    data = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    data["cost"]["actual_usd"] = 0.01  # someone edits the cost after the fact
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    tampered = {inc: b["digest"] for inc, b in audit._bundles(tmp_path / "evidence").items()}
    result = audit.c1_ledger(entries, genesis, anchors, public, tampered)
    assert result.status is Status.FAIL
    assert "is not the one the ledger records" in result.problems[0]


def test_the_incident_workflow_records_the_bundle_digest_on_its_closing_entry(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    ledger: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    closings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def emit(closing: dict[str, Any]) -> c.BundleRef:

        case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", closing["incident"])
        path, digest = bundler.emit(tmp_path / "evidence", case, closing)
        return c.BundleRef(closing["incident"], path.as_posix(), digest)

    async def scenario() -> c.Outcome:
        crew = crew_for(Scenario())
        crew.answers["emit_bundle"] = emit
        crew.answers["ledger_append"] = lambda entry: ledger.append(entry) or "h"
        crew.answers["canary_sample"] = lambda shipment, batch: [False] * 40
        alert = c.Alert(INC, "ledger", (c.Hit("k1", "d", "trace-1", "s", receptor="R-007"),))
        async with temporal(crew) as (_env, client):

                                                 task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip

    assert outcome.state == "RESOLVED"
    [closing] = closings

    assert closing["winner"]["hypothesis"] == "H1"

    path = tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "bundle.json"
    assert entry["bundle_sha256"] == file_sha256(path)  # E.2: the digest of the file on disk
    assert entry["state"] == "RESOLVED"


def test_a_bundle_that_cannot_be_written_never_keeps_the_incident_open() -> None:
    ledger: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def broken(closing: dict[str, Any]) -> c.BundleRef:
        raise OSError("disk full")

    async def scenario() -> c.Outcome:
        crew = crew_for(Scenario(repro_ok=False))
        crew.answers["emit_bundle"] = broken
        crew.answers["ledger_append"] = lambda entry: ledger.append(entry) or "h"
        alert = c.Alert("INC-0043", "ledger", ())

    assert "bundle_sha256" not in entry
    assert "disk full" in entry["bundle_error"]

"""§4.1.2: the crew's own traces. Each role runs as ``kintsugi:<role>``; a step for an incident is
a trace rooted in the ``WORKFLOW`` span ``incident:<INC>`` with session ``inc-<INC>``; every
cost line of the incident is carried on exactly one trace, so the session total equals the
recorded actuals audit C10 reconciles (and the bundle names the session)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import SPECS, StepContext
from kintsugi.crew import telemetry as t
from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.crew.factory import OmegaCrew
from kintsugi.proof import audit

INC = "INC-0042"


@pytest.fixture
def spans() -> InMemorySpanExporter:
    return InMemorySpanExporter()


def _telemetry(state: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter) -> t.CrewTelemetry:
    def provider(role: str) -> TracerProvider:
        tp = TracerProvider()
        tp.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(spans))
        return tp

    return t.CrewTelemetry(state, tracer_provider=provider)


def _step(name: str) -> StepContext:
    return StepContext(name, f"{name}:key", 1, lambda *details: None)


def test_every_activity_has_a_crew_role() -> None:
    assert set(SPECS) == set(t.ROLES)
    roles = set(t.ROLES.values())
    assert roles >= {"sentinel", "pathologist", "archivist", "surgeon", "auditor", "coordinator",
                     "immunologist", "saboteur"}  # §5.7 # fmt: skip
    assert t.workflow_name("surgeon") == "kintsugi:surgeon"
    assert t.session_id(INC) == "inc-INC-0042"


def test_the_incident_of_a_step_comes_from_its_arguments() -> None:
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    out = c.SurgeonOutcome(INC, "H1", 1, "b", "n", "sha")
    assert t.incident_of("reproduce", [sig]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("rewind", [[out]]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("ledger_append", [{"type": "incident", "incident": INC}]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("escalate", [INC, "no budget"]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("route_hit", [c.Hit("k", "d", "t", "s"), []]) is None
    assert t.incident_of("anchor_ledger", [7]) is None


def test_a_crew_step_is_a_role_trace_rooted_in_the_incident_session(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    ctx = CrewContext(state=tmp_path / "crew", targets={})
    tel = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    crew = OmegaCrew(ctx, runner=lambda: None, telemetry=tel)  # type: ignore[arg-type,return-value]
    case = CaseFile(ctx.state / "cases", INC)

    def spend(step: StepContext, sig: c.Signature) -> c.Repro:  # a step that spends money
        case.add_cost("pathologist", 0.25, "repro session")
        return c.Repro(True, "sha256:x", 3, 3)

    crew.do_reproduce = spend  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    crew.handle(_step("reproduce"), sig)
    crew.handle(_step("ledger_append"), {"type": "transition", "incident": INC})
    finished = {s.name: s for s in spans.get_finished_spans()}
    roots = [s for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name == f"incident:{INC}"]
    assert len(roots) == 2  # one trace per step, each with its incident root
    for root in roots:
        assert root.parent is None
        assert root.attributes is not None
        assert root.attributes["neatlogs.session.id"] == "inc-INC-0042"
        assert root.attributes["openinference.span.kind"] == "WORKFLOW"
    step = finished["pathologist.reproduce"]
    assert step.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:pathologist"
    assert step.attributes is not None
    assert step.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.25
    assert step.parent is not None and step.parent.span_id in {r.context.span_id for r in roots}
    notary = finished["notary.ledger_append"]
    assert notary.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:notary"
    assert notary.attributes is not None and notary.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.0
    journal = [json.loads(line) for line in tel.journal_path(INC).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [(j["workflow"], j["session"], j["cost_usd"]) for j in journal] == [
        ("kintsugi:pathologist", "inc-INC-0042", 0.25), ("kintsugi:notary", "inc-INC-0042", 0.0)]
    assert {j["trace_id"] for j in journal} == {f"{r.context.trace_id:032x}" for r in roots}
    assert all(j["exported"] is False for j in journal)  # no NEATLOGS_API_KEY: local only


def test_a_fleet_step_has_no_incident_root(tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    tel = _telemetry(tmp_path, spans)
    with tel.step("route_hit", None):
        pass
    [span] = spans.get_finished_spans()
    assert span.name == "sentinel.route_hit"
    assert span.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:sentinel"


def test_each_cost_line_is_reported_once_across_processes_and_threads(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    """Two telemetry instances (the crew and Surgeon pools) share the cursor: concurrent steps
    may split the lines, but the session total equals the case file's actuals exactly."""
    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    crew_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    surgeon_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    errors: list[BaseException] = []

    def work(tel: t.CrewTelemetry, activity: str, n: int) -> None:
        try:
            for i in range(n):
                with tel.step(activity, INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
                    case.add_cost(t.role_of(activity), 0.01 * (i + 1), f"{activity} {i}")
        except BaseException as error:  # pragma: no cover - surfaced below
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(crew_pool, "audit_gates", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 10))]  # fmt: skip
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join()
    assert errors == []
    reported = sum(float(s.attributes.get("neatlogs.agent.cost_usd", 0.0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                   for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert round(reported, 6) == case.spent()
    lines = sum(int(s.attributes.get("kintsugi.cost_lines", 0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert lines == len(case.cost_lines()) == 40


def test_the_bundle_names_the_session_c10_reconciles(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """The bundle's cost section claims the incident's session; C10 then compares the actuals
    with neatlogs' session cost (here a recorded answer equal to the telemetry total)."""
    from kintsugi.crew import bundler

    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    tel = t.CrewTelemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry")  # export disabled: the SDK's own clients
    for usd in (1.5, 2.25):
        with tel.step("surgeon", INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
            case.add_cost("surgeon", usd, "session")
    closing: dict[str, Any] = {"incident": INC, "host": "ledger", "state": "ESCALATED",
                               "reason": "budget", "traces": {"failing": []}}  # fmt: skip
    _path, _digest = bundler.emit(tmp_path / "evidence", case, closing,
                                  journal_path=tel.journal_path(INC))  # fmt: skip
    data = json.loads((tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "bundle.json").read_bytes())
    assert data["cost"]["sessions"] == ["inc-INC-0042"]
    assert data["cost"]["actual_usd"] == data["cost"]["telemetry_usd"] == 3.75
    assert (tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "telemetry" / "sessions.jsonl").is_file()
    ok = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.75})
    assert ok.status is audit.Status.PASS
    off = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.0})
    assert off.status is audit.Status.FAIL
