cost line of the incident is carried on exactly one trace, so the session total equals the
recorded actuals audit C10 reconciles (and the bundle names the session)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import SPECS, StepContext
from kintsugi.crew import telemetry as t
from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.crew.factory import OmegaCrew
from kintsugi.proof import audit

INC = "INC-0042"


@pytest.fixture
def spans() -> InMemorySpanExporter:
    return InMemorySpanExporter()


def _telemetry(state: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter) -> t.CrewTelemetry:
    def provider(role: str) -> TracerProvider:
        tp = TracerProvider()
        tp.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(spans))
        return tp

    return t.CrewTelemetry(state, tracer_provider=provider)


def _step(name: str) -> StepContext:
    return StepContext(name, f"{name}:key", 1, lambda *details: None)


def test_every_activity_has_a_crew_role() -> None:
    assert set(SPECS) == set(t.ROLES)
    roles = set(t.ROLES.values())
    assert roles >= {"sentinel", "pathologist", "archivist", "surgeon", "auditor", "coordinator",
                     "immunologist", "saboteur"}  # §5.7 # fmt: skip
    assert t.workflow_name("surgeon") == "kintsugi:surgeon"
    assert t.session_id(INC) == "inc-INC-0042"


def test_the_incident_of_a_step_comes_from_its_arguments() -> None:
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    out = c.SurgeonOutcome(INC, "H1", 1, "b", "n", "sha")
    assert t.incident_of("reproduce", [sig]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("rewind", [[out]]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("ledger_append", [{"type": "incident", "incident": INC}]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("escalate", [INC, "no budget"]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("route_hit", [c.Hit("k", "d", "t", "s"), []]) is None
    assert t.incident_of("anchor_ledger", [7]) is None


def test_a_crew_step_is_a_role_trace_rooted_in_the_incident_session(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    ctx = CrewContext(state=tmp_path / "crew", targets={})
    tel = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    crew = OmegaCrew(ctx, runner=lambda: None, telemetry=tel)  # type: ignore[arg-type,return-value]
    case = CaseFile(ctx.state / "cases", INC)

    def spend(step: StepContext, sig: c.Signature) -> c.Repro:  # a step that spends money
        case.add_cost("pathologist", 0.25, "repro session")
        return c.Repro(True, "sha256:x", 3, 3)

    crew.do_reproduce = spend  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    crew.handle(_step("reproduce"), sig)
    crew.handle(_step("ledger_append"), {"type": "transition", "incident": INC})
    finished = {s.name: s for s in spans.get_finished_spans()}
    roots = [s for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name == f"incident:{INC}"]
    assert len(roots) == 2  # one trace per step, each with its incident root
    for root in roots:
        assert root.parent is None
        assert root.attributes is not None
        assert root.attributes["neatlogs.session.id"] == "inc-INC-0042"
        assert root.attributes["openinference.span.kind"] == "WORKFLOW"
    step = finished["pathologist.reproduce"]
    assert step.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:pathologist"
    assert step.attributes is not None
    assert step.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.25
    assert step.parent is not None and step.parent.span_id in {r.context.span_id for r in roots}
    notary = finished["notary.ledger_append"]
    assert notary.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:notary"
    assert notary.attributes is not None and notary.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.0
    journal = [json.loads(line) for line in tel.journal_path(INC).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [(j["workflow"], j["session"], j["cost_usd"]) for j in journal] == [
        ("kintsugi:pathologist", "inc-INC-0042", 0.25), ("kintsugi:notary", "inc-INC-0042", 0.0)]
    assert {j["trace_id"] for j in journal} == {f"{r.context.trace_id:032x}" for r in roots}
    assert all(j["exported"] is False for j in journal)  # no NEATLOGS_API_KEY: local only


def test_a_fleet_step_has_no_incident_root(tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    tel = _telemetry(tmp_path, spans)
    with tel.step("route_hit", None):
        pass
    [span] = spans.get_finished_spans()
    assert span.name == "sentinel.route_hit"
    assert span.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:sentinel"


def test_each_cost_line_is_reported_once_across_processes_and_threads(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    """Two telemetry instances (the crew and Surgeon pools) share the cursor: concurrent steps
    may split the lines, but the session total equals the case file's actuals exactly."""
    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    crew_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    surgeon_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    errors: list[BaseException] = []

    def work(tel: t.CrewTelemetry, activity: str, n: int) -> None:
        try:
            for i in range(n):
                with tel.step(activity, INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
                    case.add_cost(t.role_of(activity), 0.01 * (i + 1), f"{activity} {i}")
        except BaseException as error:  # pragma: no cover - surfaced below
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(crew_pool, "audit_gates", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 10))]  # fmt: skip
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join()
    assert errors == []
    reported = sum(float(s.attributes.get("neatlogs.agent.cost_usd", 0.0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                   for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert round(reported, 6) == case.spent()
    lines = sum(int(s.attributes.get("kintsugi.cost_lines", 0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert lines == len(case.cost_lines()) == 40


def test_the_bundle_names_the_session_c10_reconciles(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """The bundle's cost section claims the incident's session; C10 then compares the actuals
    with neatlogs' session cost (here a recorded answer equal to the telemetry total)."""
    from kintsugi.crew import bundler

    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    tel = t.CrewTelemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry")  # export disabled: the SDK's own clients
    for usd in (1.5, 2.25):
        with tel.step("surgeon", INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
            case.add_cost("surgeon", usd, "session")
    closing: dict[str, Any] = {"incident": INC, "host": "ledger", "state": "ESCALATED",
                               "reason": "budget", "traces": {"failing": []}}  # fmt: skip
    _path, _digest = bundler.emit(tmp_path / "evidence", case, closing,
                                  journal_path=tel.journal_path(INC))  # fmt: skip
    data = json.loads((tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "bundle.json").read_bytes())
    assert data["cost"]["sessions"] == ["inc-INC-0042"]
    assert data["cost"]["actual_usd"] == data["cost"]["telemetry_usd"] == 3.75
    assert (tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "telemetry" / "sessions.jsonl").is_file()
    ok = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.75})
    assert ok.status is audit.Status.PASS
    off = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.0})
    assert off.status is audit.Status.FAIL

"""§6.6 / Appendix B: the Saboteur delivers ``healer.*`` faults through the Watchdog's chaos API.

S-18 (``healer.kill_worker`` on the Surgeon pool together with ``healer.webhook_outage``) is

and the ledger records one delivery. Faults with no chaos endpoint are refused, never faked.

import sys
import time
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from kintsugi.control import watchdog as w
from kintsugi.control.activities import DeliveryRefused
from kintsugi.crew.factory import FileLedger, OmegaCrew, SabotageLane
from kintsugi.crew.healer import HealerPort, pool_name
from kintsugi.crew.saboteur import Saboteur, compose
from kintsugi.proof import sealed
from kintsugi.proof.ledger import genesis_hash

TOKEN = "t" * 43
SLEEP = [sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(120)"]
NOW = datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0)


def _s18(**target: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    params = {"pool": "surgeon-workers",
              "together": [{"class": "healer.webhook_outage", "duration_s": 0.4}], **target}
    return compose("S-98", "healer.kill_worker", host="practice",
                   framing="Worker maintenance window",
                   ground_truth={"files": [], "mechanism": "kill and outage"},
                   not_before=(NOW - timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(), seed=18,
                   params=params)  # fmt: skip


@pytest.fixture
def chaos(tmp_path: Path) -> Any:
    """The real chaos app over a supervisor with a crew and a Surgeon pool."""
    switches: list[bool] = []
    pager = w.Pager(tmp_path / "pages.jsonl")
    sup = w.Supervisor(pager)
    sup.add(w.Pool("crew", SLEEP))
    sup.add(w.Pool("surgeon", SLEEP))
    dog = w.Watchdog(sup, pager, ingress_toggle=switches.append,
                     chaos_log=tmp_path / "chaos.jsonl")  # fmt: skip
    api = TestClient(w.chaos_app(dog, TOKEN))
    token = tmp_path / "repo" / ".state" / "watchdog" / "chaos.token"
    token.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    token.write_text(TOKEN, encoding="utf-8")

    def post(url: str, body: Mapping[str, Any], headers: Mapping[str, str]) -> tuple[int, Any]:
        response = api.post(url.removeprefix("http://127.0.0.1:8790"), json=dict(body),
                            headers=dict(headers))  # fmt: skip

    yield SimpleNamespace(port=port, sup=sup, switches=switches, log=tmp_path / "chaos.jsonl")
    sup.stop()


def test_compose_routes_healer_classes_to_the_chaos_api() -> None:
    assert _s18()["delivery"]["mode"] == "chaos_api"
    assert compose("S-97", "env.latency", host="practice", framing="f",
                   ground_truth={}, not_before=NOW.isoformat(), seed=1,
                   params={"tool": "x", "p50_ms": 1, "p95_ms": 2})["delivery"]["mode"] \
        == "chaos_proxy"  # fmt: skip
    assert pool_name("surgeon-workers") == "surgeon"


def test_s18_is_delivered_through_the_sealed_lane_to_the_chaos_api(
    chaos: Any, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    secret, recipient = sealed.new_identity()
    saboteur = Saboteur(tmp_path / "store", (recipient,), ("practice",))
    spec = _s18()
    saboteur.seal(spec)
    lane = SabotageLane(saboteur, secret, deliver=lambda req, host: "never",
                        healer=chaos.port.deliver)  # fmt: skip
    ledger = FileLedger(tmp_path / "ledger.jsonl", genesis_hash("t0", b"\0" * 32))
    crew = SimpleNamespace(ledger=ledger, sabotage=lane, _lane=lambda: lane)
    surgeon, crew_pool = chaos.sup.pid("surgeon"), chaos.sup.pid("crew")
    OmegaCrew.do_deliver_sabotage(crew, None, "S-98")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    OmegaCrew.do_deliver_sabotage(crew, None, "S-98")  # type: ignore[arg-type]  (a retry)
    assert chaos.sup.tick() == ["surgeon"]  # killed once, restarted by the Watchdog (§6.6)
    assert chaos.sup.pid("surgeon") != surgeon
    assert chaos.sup.pid("crew") == crew_pool  # the delivering pool is never the target
    assert chaos.switches == [False]
    time.sleep(1.0)
    assert chaos.switches == [False, True]  # the ingress comes back after the outage
    [entry] = list(ledger.entries())
    assert (entry["event"], entry["mode"]) == ("delivered", "chaos_api")
    assert entry["ref"] == f"kill:surgeon:pid={surgeon};ingress-outage:0.4s"
    ops = [line for line in chaos.log.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    assert len(ops) == 2 and all('"sabotage_id": "S-98"' in op for op in ops)


def test_what_the_chaos_api_cannot_do_is_refused_before_any_call(chaos: Any) -> None:
    pids = chaos.sup.pid("surgeon")
    with pytest.raises(DeliveryRefused, match="no chaos endpoint"):
        chaos.port.deliver({**_s18(), "class": "healer.entire_hook_failure"})
    with pytest.raises(DeliveryRefused, match="no chaos endpoint"):
        chaos.port.deliver(_s18(together=[{"class": "healer.neatlogs_ingest_delay",
                                           "delay_s": 60}]))  # fmt: skip
    with pytest.raises(DeliveryRefused, match="runs the delivery"):
        chaos.port.deliver(_s18(pool="crew", together=[]))
    with pytest.raises(DeliveryRefused, match="not a healer class"):
        chaos.port.deliver({**_s18(), "class": "env.latency"})
    with pytest.raises(DeliveryRefused, match=r"refused \(404\)"):
        chaos.port.deliver(_s18(pool="nope", together=[]))
    assert chaos.sup.pid("surgeon") == pids  # nothing was killed
    assert chaos.switches == []


def test_a_missing_token_is_retried_not_refused(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    port = HealerPort.for_repo(tmp_path)  # the Watchdog has not written its token yet
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="no chaos token"):
        port.deliver(_s18(together=[]))

"""§6.6 / Appendix B: the Saboteur delivers ``healer.*`` faults through the Watchdog's chaos API.

S-18 (``healer.kill_worker`` on the Surgeon pool together with ``healer.webhook_outage``) is
sealed as one spec, opened by the delivery lane and sent to the real chaos app: the Surgeon pool
is killed and restarted by the supervisor, the ingress goes dark for the outage and comes back,
and the ledger records one delivery. Faults with no chaos endpoint are refused, never faked.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import time
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from kintsugi.control import watchdog as w
from kintsugi.control.activities import DeliveryRefused
from kintsugi.crew.factory import FileLedger, OmegaCrew, SabotageLane
from kintsugi.crew.healer import HealerPort, pool_name
from kintsugi.crew.saboteur import Saboteur, compose
from kintsugi.proof import sealed
from kintsugi.proof.ledger import genesis_hash

TOKEN = "t" * 43
SLEEP = [sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(120)"]
NOW = datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0)


def _s18(**target: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    params = {"pool": "surgeon-workers",
              "together": [{"class": "healer.webhook_outage", "duration_s": 0.4}], **target}
    return compose("S-98", "healer.kill_worker", host="practice",
                   framing="Worker maintenance window",
                   ground_truth={"files": [], "mechanism": "kill and outage"},
                   not_before=(NOW - timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(), seed=18,
                   params=params)  # fmt: skip


@pytest.fixture
def chaos(tmp_path: Path) -> Any:
    """The real chaos app over a supervisor with a crew and a Surgeon pool."""
    switches: list[bool] = []
    pager = w.Pager(tmp_path / "pages.jsonl")
    sup = w.Supervisor(pager)
    sup.add(w.Pool("crew", SLEEP))
    sup.add(w.Pool("surgeon", SLEEP))
    dog = w.Watchdog(sup, pager, ingress_toggle=switches.append,
                     chaos_log=tmp_path / "chaos.jsonl")  # fmt: skip
    api = TestClient(w.chaos_app(dog, TOKEN))
    token = tmp_path / "repo" / ".state" / "watchdog" / "chaos.token"
    token.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    token.write_text(TOKEN, encoding="utf-8")

    def post(url: str, body: Mapping[str, Any], headers: Mapping[str, str]) -> tuple[int, Any]:
        response = api.post(url.removeprefix("http://127.0.0.1:8790"), json=dict(body),
                            headers=dict(headers))  # fmt: skip
        return response.status_code, response.json()

    port = HealerPort.for_repo(tmp_path / "repo")
    port.post = post
    yield SimpleNamespace(port=port, sup=sup, switches=switches, log=tmp_path / "chaos.jsonl")
    sup.stop()


def test_compose_routes_healer_classes_to_the_chaos_api() -> None:
    assert _s18()["delivery"]["mode"] == "chaos_api"
    assert compose("S-97", "env.latency", host="practice", framing="f",
                   ground_truth={}, not_before=NOW.isoformat(), seed=1,
                   params={"tool": "x", "p50_ms": 1, "p95_ms": 2})["delivery"]["mode"] \
        == "chaos_proxy"  # fmt: skip
    assert pool_name("surgeon-workers") == "surgeon"


def test_s18_is_delivered_through_the_sealed_lane_to_the_chaos_api(
    chaos: Any, tmp_path: Path

    secret, recipient = sealed.new_identity()
    saboteur = Saboteur(tmp_path / "store", (recipient,), ("practice",))
    spec = _s18()
    saboteur.seal(spec)
    lane = SabotageLane(saboteur, secret, deliver=lambda req, host: "never",
                        healer=chaos.port.deliver)  # fmt: skip
    ledger = FileLedger(tmp_path / "ledger.jsonl", genesis_hash("t0", b"\0" * 32))
    crew = SimpleNamespace(ledger=ledger, sabotage=lane, _lane=lambda: lane)
    surgeon, crew_pool = chaos.sup.pid("surgeon"), chaos.sup.pid("crew")
    OmegaCrew.do_deliver_sabotage(crew, None, "S-98")  # type: ignore[arg-type]

def test_the_supervisor_routes_dedupes_limits_and_answers_queries() -> None:
    async def scenario() -> dict[str, Any]:
        gate = threading.Event()
        crew = crew_for(Scenario(gate=gate))
        config = c.ControlConfig(max_open_per_host=1, canary_interval_s=1.0)
        async with temporal(crew) as (_env, client):
            sup = await client.start_workflow(FleetSupervisor.run, args=[config, None],
                                              id=config.supervisor_id, task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.budget_update, args=["ledger", 71.70])
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.hit, hit(1))  # opens INC-R-007-ledger
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.hit, hit(1))  # duplicate key: ignored
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.hit, hit(2))  # attaches to the open incident
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.hit, hit(3, receptor="R-001"))  # same host: waits
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.hit, hit(4, host="scout"))  # another host: opens
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.pause_antibody, "AB-3")

            async def two_open() -> bool:
                return len(await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.open_incidents)) == 2

            await wait_for(two_open)
            mid = await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.status)
            open_now = await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.open_incidents)
            budget = await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.budget, "ledger")
            gate.set()  # let the Surgeons finish: incidents close and the waiting one starts

            async def all_closed() -> bool:
                status = await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.status)
                return len(status["closed"]) == 3 and status["open"] == 0

            await wait_for(all_closed, timeout=60)
            final = await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.status)
            await sup.terminate("test over")
        return {"mid": mid, "open": open_now, "budget": budget, "final": final,
                "routes": crew.count("route_hit")}  # fmt: skip

    out = run(scenario())
    assert out["open"] == {"INC-R-007-ledger": "ledger", "INC-R-007-scout": "scout"}
    assert out["mid"]["waiting"] == 1  # the second ledger incident waits for the first
    assert out["mid"]["paused_antibodies"] == ["AB-3"]
    assert out["budget"] == 71.70
    assert out["routes"] == 4  # the duplicate hit never reached the Sentinel
    assert set(out["final"]["closed"]) == {"INC-R-007-ledger", "INC-R-007-scout",
                                           "INC-R-001-ledger"}  # fmt: skip
    assert set(out["final"]["closed"].values()) == {"RESOLVED"}

    async def scenario() -> tuple[int, int]:

                                              id="sup-pause", task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip

            held = (await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.status))["pending"]
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.operator_resume)

            async def drained() -> bool:
                return (await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.status))["pending"] == 0

            await wait_for(drained)
            await sup.terminate("test over")
        return held, crew.count("route_hit")

    held, routed = run(scenario())
    assert held == 3
    assert routed == 3

"""L4 (§6.4): the main watcher polls ``origin/main`` and signals drift into open incidents.

``kintsugi control watch-main`` (started by ``scripts/w-runtime.sh``) fetches the remote branch,
reports each move once, never loses one whose signal failed, and its drift reaches a running
Incident through the FleetSupervisor, which re-verifies the round on the new main.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from kintsugi.cli import _build_parser
from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control import service as svc
from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW
from kintsugi.control.workflows import FleetSupervisor
from kintsugi.sandbox import proc
from kintsugi.senses.drift import Drift, MainWatcher
from tests.helpers.control import Scenario, crew_for, temporal


def _git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    return proc.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], timeout_s=60, check=True).stdout.strip()


@pytest.fixture
def world(tmp_path: Path) -> dict[str, Path]:
    """A bare origin, the runtime's checkout of it, and an upstream clone that pushes."""
    if proc.which("git") is None:
        pytest.skip("git is not installed")
    origin = tmp_path / "origin.git"
    proc.run(["git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", str(origin)], timeout_s=30, check=True)
    upstream = tmp_path / "upstream"
    proc.run(["git", "clone", "-q", str(origin), str(upstream)], timeout_s=60, check=True)
    for args in (("user.name", "t"), ("user.email", "t@example.invalid")):
        _git(upstream, "config", *args)
    _git(upstream, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "main")
    (upstream / "a.txt").write_text("1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    _git(upstream, "add", "-A")
    _git(upstream, "commit", "-q", "-m", "one")
    _git(upstream, "push", "-q", "origin", "main")
    checkout = tmp_path / "omega"
    proc.run(["git", "clone", "-q", str(origin), str(checkout)], timeout_s=60, check=True)
    return {"origin": origin, "upstream": upstream, "checkout": checkout, "tmp": tmp_path}


def _push(upstream: Path, text: str) -> str:
    (upstream / "a.txt").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    _git(upstream, "commit", "-q", "-am", text.strip())
    _git(upstream, "push", "-q", "origin", "main")
    return _git(upstream, "rev-parse", "HEAD")


def test_the_watcher_fetches_origin_main_and_reports_each_move_once(world: dict[str, Path]) -> None:
    seen: list[Drift] = []
    state = world["tmp"] / "heads.json"
    watcher = MainWatcher({"omega": world["checkout"]}, seen.append, state_path=state,
                          remote="origin")  # fmt: skip
    assert watcher.poll_once() == []  # the first poll records the head
    old = _git(world["checkout"], "rev-parse", "origin/main")
    new = _push(world["upstream"], "2\n")  # pushed upstream; nobody pulls the checkout
    assert watcher.poll_once() == [Drift("omega", old, new)]
    assert _git(world["checkout"], "cat-file", "-t", new) == "commit"  # there for the graph diff
    assert watcher.poll_once() == []
    assert seen == [Drift("omega", old, new)]


def test_a_drift_whose_signal_failed_is_reported_again(world: dict[str, Path]) -> None:
    calls: list[Drift] = []

    def flaky(drift: Drift) -> None:
        calls.append(drift)
        if len(calls) == 1:
            raise ConnectionError("temporal is restarting")

    state = world["tmp"] / "heads.json"
    watcher = MainWatcher({"omega": world["checkout"]}, flaky, state_path=state, remote="origin")
    watcher.poll_once()
    new = _push(world["upstream"], "3\n")
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        watcher.poll_once()
    restarted = MainWatcher({"omega": world["checkout"]}, flaky, state_path=state,
                            remote="origin")  # fmt: skip
    assert [d.new_main for d in restarted.poll_once()] == [new]  # not lost across a restart
    assert [d.new_main for d in calls] == [new, new]


def test_the_cli_and_the_launcher_run_the_watcher() -> None:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args(["control", "watch-main", "--target", "127.0.0.1:7233",
                                       "--remote", "origin", "--interval", "30"])  # fmt: skip
    assert (args.control_command, args.remote, args.branch) == ("watch-main", "origin", "main")
    launcher = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "w-runtime.sh").read_text(
        encoding="utf-8")  # fmt: skip
    assert "spawn watch-main uv run kintsugi control watch-main" in launcher
    assert "SERVICES=(temporal watchdog forward watch-main ingress poller fleet)" in launcher


def test_drift_on_origin_main_reaches_the_open_incident_through_the_supervisor(
    world: dict[str, Path],
) -> None:
    rebased: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    async def scenario() -> dict[str, Any]:
        gate = threading.Event()
        crew = crew_for(Scenario(passing={0: 1}, gate=gate))
        crew.answers["rebase_and_rerun"] = lambda outs, repo, new: rebased.append((repo, new))
        config = c.ControlConfig(canary_interval_s=1.0, supervisor_id="sup-l4")
        state = world["tmp"] / "main-watch.json"
        async with temporal(crew) as (_env, client):
            sup = await client.start_workflow(FleetSupervisor.run, args=[config, None],
                                              id=config.supervisor_id, task_queue=CREW)  # fmt: skip

            async def signal(repo: str, new_main: str) -> None:
                await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.drift, args=[repo, new_main])

            async def watch() -> int:
                return await svc.watch_main("unused", {"omega": world["checkout"]},
                                            config.supervisor_id, state_path=state, once=True,
                                            signal=signal, log=lambda line: None)  # fmt: skip

            assert await watch() == 0  # records origin/main before any incident exists
            await sup.signal(FleetSupervisor.hit, c.Hit("k1", "det", "trace-1", "span",
                                                         receptor="R-007", host="ledger"))
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
            while crew.count("surgeon") == 0:  # a round is in flight
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline
                await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
            new = _push(world["upstream"], "4\n")  # S-19's shape: main moves mid-repair
            assert await watch() == 1
            gate.set()

            async def closed() -> bool:
                return len((await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.status))["closed"]) == 1

            while not await closed():
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline + 30
                await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            final = await sup.query(FleetSupervisor.status)
            await sup.terminate("test over")
        return {"new": new, "final": final}

    out = asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert out["final"]["closed"] == {"INC-R-007-ledger": "RESOLVED"}
    assert ("omega", out["new"]) in rebased  # the incident re-verified on the new main

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import SPECS, StepContext

from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile

INC = "INC-0042"


@pytest.fixture
def spans() -> InMemorySpanExporter:
    return InMemorySpanExporter()


def _telemetry(state: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter) -> t.CrewTelemetry:
    def provider(role: str) -> TracerProvider:
        tp = TracerProvider()
        tp.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(spans))
        return tp

    return t.CrewTelemetry(state, tracer_provider=provider)


def _step(name: str) -> StepContext:
    return StepContext(name, f"{name}:key", 1, lambda *details: None)


def test_every_activity_has_a_crew_role() -> None:
    assert set(SPECS) == set(t.ROLES)
    roles = set(t.ROLES.values())
    assert roles >= {"sentinel", "pathologist", "archivist", "surgeon", "auditor", "coordinator",
                     "immunologist", "saboteur"}  # §5.7 # fmt: skip
    assert t.workflow_name("surgeon") == "kintsugi:surgeon"
    assert t.session_id(INC) == "inc-INC-0042"


def test_the_incident_of_a_step_comes_from_its_arguments() -> None:
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    out = c.SurgeonOutcome(INC, "H1", 1, "b", "n", "sha")
    assert t.incident_of("reproduce", [sig]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("rewind", [[out]]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("ledger_append", [{"type": "incident", "incident": INC}]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("escalate", [INC, "no budget"]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("route_hit", [c.Hit("k", "d", "t", "s"), []]) is None
    assert t.incident_of("anchor_ledger", [7]) is None


def test_a_crew_step_is_a_role_trace_rooted_in_the_incident_session(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    ctx = CrewContext(state=tmp_path / "crew", targets={})
    tel = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    crew = OmegaCrew(ctx, runner=lambda: None, telemetry=tel)  # type: ignore[arg-type,return-value]
    case = CaseFile(ctx.state / "cases", INC)

    def spend(step: StepContext, sig: c.Signature) -> c.Repro:  # a step that spends money
        case.add_cost("pathologist", 0.25, "repro session")
        return c.Repro(True, "sha256:x", 3, 3)

    crew.do_reproduce = spend  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    crew.handle(_step("reproduce"), sig)
    crew.handle(_step("ledger_append"), {"type": "transition", "incident": INC})
    finished = {s.name: s for s in spans.get_finished_spans()}
    roots = [s for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name == f"incident:{INC}"]
    assert len(roots) == 2  # one trace per step, each with its incident root
    for root in roots:
        assert root.parent is None
        assert root.attributes is not None
        assert root.attributes["neatlogs.session.id"] == "inc-INC-0042"
        assert root.attributes["openinference.span.kind"] == "WORKFLOW"
    step = finished["pathologist.reproduce"]
    assert step.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:pathologist"
    assert step.attributes is not None
    assert step.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.25
    assert step.parent is not None
    assert step.parent.span_id in {r.context.span_id for r in roots}
    notary = finished["notary.ledger_append"]
    assert notary.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:notary"
    assert notary.attributes is not None
    assert notary.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.0
    journal = [json.loads(line) for line in tel.journal_path(INC).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [(j["workflow"], j["session"], j["cost_usd"]) for j in journal] == [
        ("kintsugi:pathologist", "inc-INC-0042", 0.25),
        ("kintsugi:notary", "inc-INC-0042", 0.0),

    assert {j["trace_id"] for j in journal} == {f"{r.context.trace_id:032x}" for r in roots}
    assert all(j["exported"] is False for j in journal)  # no NEATLOGS_API_KEY: local only

    [span] = spans.get_finished_spans()

def test_each_cost_line_is_reported_once_across_processes_and_threads(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    """Two telemetry instances (the crew and Surgeon pools) share the cursor: concurrent steps
    may split the lines, but the session total equals the case file's actuals exactly."""
    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    crew_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    surgeon_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    errors: list[BaseException] = []

    def work(tel: t.CrewTelemetry, activity: str, n: int) -> None:
        try:
            for i in range(n):
                with tel.step(activity, INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
                    case.add_cost(t.role_of(activity), 0.01 * (i + 1), f"{activity} {i}")
        except BaseException as error:  # pragma: no cover - surfaced below
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(crew_pool, "audit_gates", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 10))]  # fmt: skip
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join()
    assert errors == []
    reported = sum(float(s.attributes.get("neatlogs.agent.cost_usd", 0.0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                   for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert round(reported, 6) == case.spent()
    lines = sum(int(s.attributes.get("kintsugi.cost_lines", 0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert lines == len(case.cost_lines()) == 40


def test_the_bundle_names_the_session_c10_reconciles(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """The bundle's cost section claims the incident's session; C10 then compares the actuals
    with neatlogs' session cost (here a recorded answer equal to the telemetry total)."""
    from kintsugi.crew import bundler

    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    tel = t.CrewTelemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry")  # export disabled: the SDK's own clients
    for usd in (1.5, 2.25):
        with tel.step("surgeon", INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
            case.add_cost("surgeon", usd, "session")
    closing: dict[str, Any] = {"incident": INC, "host": "ledger", "state": "ESCALATED",
                               "reason": "budget", "traces": {"failing": []}}  # fmt: skip
    _path, _digest = bundler.emit(tmp_path / "evidence", case, closing,
                                  journal_path=tel.journal_path(INC))  # fmt: skip
    data = json.loads((tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "bundle.json").read_bytes())
    assert data["cost"]["sessions"] == ["inc-INC-0042"]
    assert data["cost"]["actual_usd"] == data["cost"]["telemetry_usd"] == 3.75
    assert (tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "telemetry" / "sessions.jsonl").is_file()
    ok = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.75})
    assert ok.status is audit.Status.PASS
    off = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.0})
    assert off.status is audit.Status.FAIL

"""§4.1.2: the crew's own traces. Each role runs as ``kintsugi:<role>``; a step for an incident is
a trace rooted in the ``WORKFLOW`` span ``incident:<INC>`` with session ``inc-<INC>``; every
cost line of the incident is carried on exactly one trace, so the session total equals the
recorded actuals audit C10 reconciles (and the bundle names the session)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.control.activities import SPECS, StepContext
from kintsugi.crew import telemetry as t
from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.crew.factory import OmegaCrew
from kintsugi.proof import audit

INC = "INC-0042"


@pytest.fixture
def spans() -> InMemorySpanExporter:
    return InMemorySpanExporter()


def _telemetry(state: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter) -> t.CrewTelemetry:
    def provider(role: str) -> TracerProvider:
        tp = TracerProvider()
        tp.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(spans))
        return tp

    return t.CrewTelemetry(state, tracer_provider=provider)


def _step(name: str) -> StepContext:
    return StepContext(name, f"{name}:key", 1, lambda *details: None)


def test_every_activity_has_a_crew_role() -> None:
    assert set(SPECS) == set(t.ROLES)
    roles = set(t.ROLES.values())
    assert roles >= {"sentinel", "pathologist", "archivist", "surgeon", "auditor", "coordinator",
                     "immunologist", "saboteur"}  # §5.7 # fmt: skip
    assert t.workflow_name("surgeon") == "kintsugi:surgeon"
    assert t.session_id(INC) == "inc-INC-0042"


def test_the_incident_of_a_step_comes_from_its_arguments() -> None:
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    out = c.SurgeonOutcome(INC, "H1", 1, "b", "n", "sha")
    assert t.incident_of("reproduce", [sig]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("rewind", [[out]]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("ledger_append", [{"type": "incident", "incident": INC}]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("escalate", [INC, "no budget"]) == INC
    assert t.incident_of("route_hit", [c.Hit("k", "d", "t", "s"), []]) is None
    assert t.incident_of("anchor_ledger", [7]) is None


def test_a_crew_step_is_a_role_trace_rooted_in_the_incident_session(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    ctx = CrewContext(state=tmp_path / "crew", targets={})
    tel = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    crew = OmegaCrew(ctx, runner=lambda: None, telemetry=tel)  # type: ignore[arg-type,return-value]
    case = CaseFile(ctx.state / "cases", INC)

    def spend(step: StepContext, sig: c.Signature) -> c.Repro:  # a step that spends money
        case.add_cost("pathologist", 0.25, "repro session")
        return c.Repro(True, "sha256:x", 3, 3)

    crew.do_reproduce = spend  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    sig = c.Signature(INC, "ledger", "phi", ("t1",))
    crew.handle(_step("reproduce"), sig)
    crew.handle(_step("ledger_append"), {"type": "transition", "incident": INC})
    finished = {s.name: s for s in spans.get_finished_spans()}
    roots = [s for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name == f"incident:{INC}"]
    assert len(roots) == 2  # one trace per step, each with its incident root
    for root in roots:
        assert root.parent is None
        assert root.attributes is not None
        assert root.attributes["neatlogs.session.id"] == "inc-INC-0042"
        assert root.attributes["openinference.span.kind"] == "WORKFLOW"
    step = finished["pathologist.reproduce"]
    assert step.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:pathologist"
    assert step.attributes is not None
    assert step.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.25
    assert step.parent is not None
    assert step.parent.span_id in {r.get_span_context().span_id for r in roots}
    notary = finished["notary.ledger_append"]
    assert notary.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:notary"
    assert notary.attributes is not None
    assert notary.attributes["neatlogs.agent.cost_usd"] == 0.0
    journal = [json.loads(line) for line in tel.journal_path(INC).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [(j["workflow"], j["session"], j["cost_usd"]) for j in journal] == [
        ("kintsugi:pathologist", "inc-INC-0042", 0.25),
        ("kintsugi:notary", "inc-INC-0042", 0.0),
    ]
    traces = {f"{r.get_span_context().trace_id:032x}" for r in roots}
    assert {j["trace_id"] for j in journal} == traces
    assert all(j["exported"] is False for j in journal)  # no NEATLOGS_API_KEY: local only


def test_a_fleet_step_has_no_incident_root(tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    tel = _telemetry(tmp_path, spans)
    with tel.step("route_hit", None):
        pass
    [span] = spans.get_finished_spans()
    assert span.name == "sentinel.route_hit"
    assert span.resource.attributes["neatlogs.workflow_name"] == "kintsugi:sentinel"


def test_each_cost_line_is_reported_once_across_processes_and_threads(
    tmp_path: Path, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    """Two telemetry instances (the crew and Surgeon pools) share the cursor: concurrent steps
    may split the lines, but the session total equals the case file's actuals exactly."""
    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    crew_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    surgeon_pool = _telemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry", spans)
    errors: list[BaseException] = []

    def work(tel: t.CrewTelemetry, activity: str, n: int) -> None:
        try:
            for i in range(n):
                with tel.step(activity, INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
                    case.add_cost(t.role_of(activity), 0.01 * (i + 1), f"{activity} {i}")
        except BaseException as error:  # pragma: no cover - surfaced below
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(crew_pool, "audit_gates", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 15)),
               threading.Thread(target=work, args=(surgeon_pool, "surgeon", 10))]  # fmt: skip
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join()
    assert errors == []
    reported = sum(float(s.attributes.get("neatlogs.agent.cost_usd", 0.0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                   for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert round(reported, 6) == case.spent()
    lines = sum(int(s.attributes.get("kintsugi.cost_lines", 0))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                for s in spans.get_finished_spans() if s.name.count(".") == 1)  # fmt: skip
    assert lines == len(case.cost_lines()) == 40


def test_the_bundle_names_the_session_c10_reconciles(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """The bundle's cost section claims the incident's session; C10 then compares the actuals
    with neatlogs' session cost (here a recorded answer equal to the telemetry total)."""
    from kintsugi.crew import bundler

    case = CaseFile(tmp_path / "cases", INC)
    tel = t.CrewTelemetry(tmp_path / "telemetry")  # export disabled: the SDK's own clients
    for usd in (1.5, 2.25):
        with tel.step("surgeon", INC, cost_lines=lambda inc: case.cost_lines()):
            case.add_cost("surgeon", usd, "session")
    closing: dict[str, Any] = {"incident": INC, "host": "ledger", "state": "ESCALATED",
                               "reason": "budget", "traces": {"failing": []}}  # fmt: skip
    _path, _digest = bundler.emit(tmp_path / "evidence", case, closing,
                                  journal_path=tel.journal_path(INC))  # fmt: skip
    data = json.loads((tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "bundle.json").read_bytes())
    assert data["cost"]["sessions"] == ["inc-INC-0042"]
    assert data["cost"]["actual_usd"] == data["cost"]["telemetry_usd"] == 3.75
    assert (tmp_path / "evidence" / INC / "telemetry" / "sessions.jsonl").is_file()
    ok = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.75})
    assert ok.status is audit.Status.PASS
    off = audit.c10_cost(data["cost"]["actual_usd"], {"inc-INC-0042": 3.0})
    assert off.status is audit.Status.FAIL

# Stage verification records

Each stage's verification targets (from `docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md` §4) with the result and the
evidence that reproduces it. Numbers are copied from committed artifacts or from the named test.

## Summary for #neatHack judges

| Claim | Where it is verified |
|---|---|
| A crew repaired a real agent regression and proved it with gates G0–G7 | Stage 6 (`INC-R235459-0001`, $0.665) |
| The fix became an antibody that matured on another host (PR #7, G4 p=0.0156), scored receptor precision 1.00 over 335 runs and found 6 silent past failures ($12.00) | Stage 7 |
| Repeat repairs cost ~7× less: vaccinations $0.089 and $0.104 vs $0.665 | Stage 7, `evidence/rehearsals/l3-20261012-074523.json` (`costs`) |
| A harmful vaccination was caught by the canary and auto-reverted through an attested notary session (PRs #8–#10, a **disclosed drill**) | Stage 7 |
| `kintsugi audit` C1–C14 catches tampering of every kind it checks | Stage 8, 33 mutation tests |
| The autonomous window W was **not run**; Stages 9–12 are **descoped** | Architect's go/no-go, 2026-10-12; README "Disclosure" |
| Master Edition (after the submission): Stages 13a, 9 and 12 and offline Stage 10/11 modules built and verified offline | "Master Edition overnight run" below |
| Master Edition offline items: placeholder runway, OSS-1 onboarding rehearsal, Arena board and service; full suite **970 passed, 30 skipped** in one run | "Master Edition offline items" below |
| Audit-gap closure (13 gaps): **1018 passed, 30 skipped** in one run on `57c6938`; `kintsugi demo` C1, C6 PASS | "Audit-gap closure" below |

## Audit-gap closure (2026-10-13): the 13 gaps of the read-only audit

Recorded 2026-10-13 12:40–15:30 IST on Windows 11 (Entire 0.11.4, entire-graph v0.4.0) in five
blocks the Architect ordered, plus one CI fix. Amendments A-76 … A-80. Offline; no model session,
no foreign repository, no neatlogs or cfo.ai call. Every commit carries one verified
`Entire-Checkpoint` whose `files_touched` covers it.

| Gap | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 An Arena request could fail `SabotageCampaign` | ✅ env faults delivered as chaos-proxy overlays (all five classes; background draws unchanged; the proxy logs the sabotage id); `DeliveryRefused` is non-retryable; on a time-skipping Temporal server a refused and an always-failing delivery are recorded and S-17/S-18 are still delivered | `tests/sandbox/test_chaos_overlay.py`, `tests/control/test_workflows.py::test_a_failed_delivery_never_stops_the_sealed_schedule`, `tests/crew/test_saboteur.py` (A-76) |
| 2 `onboard_step` had no handler (37 of 38) | ✅ 38 of 38; the desk runs O1–O7 | `tests/crew/test_crew_handlers.py` (A-77) |
| 3 Onboarding vs §5.9.4 | ✅ steps renamed and filled as §5.9.4 (sandbox copy, instrumentation patch on the copy, entire-graph index, eval split with a holdout manifest, baseline cost and p95); `kintsugi onboard run` and the OSS-1 rehearsal go through the `Onboarding` workflow; ⚠ still different: no dependency install offline, deterministic O3, no cassettes from exports (A-77) | `tests/onboard/test_onboarding_workflow.py`, `evidence/rehearsals/oss1-20261013-073328.json` |
| 4 The scanner missed span-declared tools | ✅ CRM practice: `enrich`, `create_contact`, `list_contacts`; `create_contact` side-effecting; HTTP calls through `external.call(..., "POST", ...)` found | same |
| 5 A passing trace became a failure seed | ✅ 21 seeds and 1 transient retry (CT-023) on the OSS-1 traces; the baseline counts the retry as passed | same |
| 6 Arena panels vs §7.7 | ✅ open incidents and last canary per host, vulnerable / n/a cells, log-log curve with the empirical slope, last anchor; checked in a browser over a scratch W ledger at 1280 px and 375 px | `tests/test_arena_service.py` (A-78) |
| 7 Spec ids after a database reset | ✅ a reset never reuses a sealed id; 16 concurrent allocations unique | same |
| 8 §10 scenarios | ✅ reproduces §10 from its drivers: Base 31/73.0%, 116/80.2%, breakeven 10, lowest $80.9k; Growth 54/76.2%, 405/83.8%, 7, $101.6k; Network 31/79.0%, 116/85.1%, 9, $84.7k; exported from the plan's placeholder cash (labelled) | `tests/econ/test_scenarios.py`, `business/cfo_export/scenarios.csv` (A-79) |
| 9 `kintsugi demo` was a stub | ✅ sealed practice spec → T0 → delivery → anchor → reveal → **C1 PASS (3 entries, 1 anchor), C6 PASS (1/1, 0 honeytoken hits), exit 0**, ~8 s; also in CI | `tests/test_cli.py`, the `audit` workflow's demo job (A-80) |
| 10 `traces.feedback` had no caller | ✅ culprit span after attribution, verdict after the canary; idempotent keys; recorded as skipped without an OAuth token | `tests/senses/test_feedback.py` |
| 11 No `audit.yml` | ✅ C1–C14 offline on every push, daily and on demand; fails only on exit 1; green on its first run | `.github/workflows/audit.yml`, `tests/test_audit_workflow.py` |
| 12 Stale docs | ✅ the crew factory's docstring; the CLI's stub table removed | — |
| 13 Missing tests | ✅ `arena_state` on a real ledger branch written by t0 genesis; trace exports carry metered cost (24/24 OSS-1 traces, $0.0752) and model tokens | `tests/test_arena_service.py`, `tests/onboard/test_oss1_rehearsal.py` |
| `kintsugi audit --all --offline ./published-bundles` | exit **2**, by design: C11 PASS (1 antibody, 1 quarantine), C14 PASS (0/0), C13 SKIP (3/3 manifests match, no T0 record), the rest SKIP (no window record). Exit 0 needs a real window: a check without its inputs is SKIP, never PASS (A-67) | run 2026-10-13 |
| Full suite, one run | ✅ **1018 passed, 30 skipped** in 15 min 54 s on `57c6938` | `uv run pytest -q` |

### Defects found while building, all fixed

- omega-ci red on `640e046`: three parallel Surgeons opened the attempt log at once and one died
  with "database is locked" (every connection switched the file to WAL before setting a busy
  timeout, and none was closed); latent since Stage 5. Fixed in `8f8de50` for the attempt log,
  the step ledger and the incident store, with a 12-thread regression test.
- omega-ci red on `57c6938` (1017 passed, 1 failed; the same HEAD passed 1018/1018 locally):
  `test_the_supervisor_continues_as_new_and_keeps_its_state` queried the supervisor while it
  was continuing as new and got "query deadline exceeded"; the test's later wait already
  tolerated that, its first wait and final reads did not. Test-only fix in the docs commit,
  5/5 passes locally.
- omega-ci red on `0c33206`: the W rehearsal's C6 failed with "delivered before not_before". The
  ledger floors `at` to whole seconds while `not_before` keeps microseconds, and the crew gated
  delivery on the precise time, so a delivery in `not_before`'s own second was recorded before
  it (latent since Stage 13a; it would also have hit Arena deliveries in W). The gate now
  compares at the ledger's precision (`factory.deliverable`); C6 stays strict; regression test.

entries.name: Monitor
entries.description:
Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.

Pick by how many notifications you need:
- **One** ("tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q "Ready in" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.
- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** ("tell me every time an ERROR line appears") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).
- **One per occurrence, until a known end** ("emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.

Your script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.

  # Each matching log line is an event
  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered "ERROR"

  # Each file change is an event
  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir

  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment
  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  while true; do
    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
    gh api "repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last" --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login): \(.body)"'
    last=$now; sleep 30
  done

  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)
  node watch-for-events.js

  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes
  prev=""
  while true; do
    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)
    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!="pending") | "\(.name): \(.bucket)"' <<<"$s" | sort)
    comm -13 <(echo "$prev") <(echo "$cur")
    prev=$cur
    jq -e 'all(.bucket!="pending")' <<<"$s" >/dev/null && break
    sleep 30
  done

**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For "tell me when X is ready," use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.

**Script quality:**
- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.
- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.
- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.
- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification ("errors in deploy.log" not "watching logs").
- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)

**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to "still running." Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.

  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit
  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered "elapsed_steps="

  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on
  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM"

For poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.

**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means "the lines you'd act on," not "only good news." Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.

Stdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.

The script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 30 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.
**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.

  Monitor({
    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},
    description: 'deploy events',
  })

Each text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.

Prefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 1800000ms are capped to 1800000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

1	"""The Saboteur's healer port: ``healer.*`` faults through the Watchdog's chaos API (§6.6, App. B).
2	
3	S-18 is ``healer.kill_worker(pool="surgeon-workers")`` together with
4	``healer.webhook_outage(duration_s=300)``, "both delivered through the Watchdog's chaos API".
5	One sealed spec carries both: its own class and parameters, plus ``target.together``, a list of
6	further healer actions (``{"class": "healer.webhook_outage", "duration_s": 300}``), delivered in
7	order under the same sabotage id.
8	
9	- ``healer.kill_worker`` → ``POST /chaos/kill {pool, sabotage_id}``. Pool names follow the
10	  Watchdog's pools (``crew``, ``surgeon``); the spec's ``surgeon-workers`` form is accepted. The
11	  pool that runs the delivery itself (``crew``) is refused: it would kill the step mid-delivery.
12	- ``healer.webhook_outage`` → ``POST /chaos/ingress {available: false, duration_s, sabotage_id}``.
13	- ``healer.neatlogs_ingest_delay`` and ``healer.entire_hook_failure`` have no chaos endpoint:
14	  refused (non-retryable), never pretended.
15	
16	The bearer token is the Watchdog's own (``.state/watchdog/chaos.token``), read at delivery time
17	so the crew can be built before the Watchdog has written it. A 4xx answer is a refusal
18	(``DeliveryRefused``, not retried); a 5xx or a connection error is retried by the activity.
19	"""
20	
21	from __future__ import annotations
22	
23	from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
24	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
25	from pathlib import Path
26	from typing import Any
27	
28	from kintsugi.control.activities import DeliveryRefused
29	
30	TOKEN_FILE = Path(".state") / "watchdog" / "chaos.token"
31	DEFAULT_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8790"
32	ENDPOINTLESS = ("healer.neatlogs_ingest_delay", "healer.entire_hook_failure")
33	
34	# (url, json body, headers) → (status code, json answer). httpx by default; tests pass the app.
35	Post = Callable[[str, Mapping[str, Any], Mapping[str, str]], tuple[int, Any]]
36	
37	
38	def _httpx_post(url: str, body: Mapping[str, Any], headers: Mapping[str, str]) -> tuple[int, Any]:
39	    import httpx
40	
41	    response = httpx.post(url, json=dict(body), headers=dict(headers), timeout=30)
42	    try:
43	        answer = response.json()
44	    except ValueError:
45	        answer = {"text": response.text[:200]}
46	    return response.status_code, answer
47	
48	
49	def pool_name(pool: str) -> str:
50	    """``surgeon-workers`` (the spec's form) → ``surgeon`` (the Watchdog's pool)."""
51	    return pool.removesuffix("-workers")
52	
53	
54	@dataclass
55	class HealerPort:
56	    token_path: Path
57	    url: str = DEFAULT_URL
58	    own_pools: tuple[str, ...] = ("crew",)
59	    post: Post = field(default=_httpx_post)
60	
61	    @classmethod
62	    def for_repo(cls, repo: Path, url: str = DEFAULT_URL) -> HealerPort:
63	        return cls(Path(repo) / TOKEN_FILE, url)
64	
65	    def actions(self, spec: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
66	        target = dict(spec.get("target") or {})
67	        together = target.pop("together", None) or []
68	        actions = [(str(spec["class"]), target)]
69	        for extra in together:
70	            params = dict(extra)
71	            actions.append((str(params.pop("class", "")), params))
72	        for cls, _ in actions:
73	            if not cls.startswith("healer."):
74	                raise DeliveryRefused(f"{spec.get('id')}: {cls!r} is not a healer class")
75	            if cls in ENDPOINTLESS:
76	                raise DeliveryRefused(f"{spec.get('id')}: no chaos endpoint delivers {cls}")
77	        return actions
78	
79	    def deliver(self, spec: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
80	        """Every action of the spec, in order; returns the references joined by ``;``."""
81	        sid = str(spec.get("id") or "")
82	        if not sid:
83	            raise DeliveryRefused("a chaos call names its sealed sabotage: the spec has no id")
84	        actions = self.actions(spec)  # all refusals before the first call
85	        return ";".join(self._one(sid, cls, params) for cls, params in actions)
86	
87	    def _token(self) -> str:
88	        if not self.token_path.is_file():
89	            raise RuntimeError(f"no chaos token at {self.token_path}: is the Watchdog running?")
90	        return self.token_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
91	
92	    def _call(self, path: str, body: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Any:
93	        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._token()}"}
94	        status, answer = self.post(f"{self.url.rstrip('/')}{path}", body, headers)
95	        if 400 <= status < 500:
96	            raise DeliveryRefused(f"chaos API {path} refused ({status}): {answer}")
97	        if status >= 300:
98	            raise RuntimeError(f"chaos API {path} failed ({status}): {answer}")
99	        return answer
100	
101	    def _one(self, sid: str, cls: str, params: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
102	        if cls == "healer.kill_worker":
103	            pool = pool_name(str(params.get("pool", "")))
104	            if pool in self.own_pools:
105	                raise DeliveryRefused(f"{sid}: {pool} runs the delivery; it cannot be its target")
106	            answer = self._call("/chaos/kill", {"pool": pool, "sabotage_id": sid})
107	            return f"kill:{pool}:pid={answer.get('pid')}"
108	        if cls == "healer.webhook_outage":
109	            duration = float(params.get("duration_s", 0))
110	            if duration <= 0:
111	                raise DeliveryRefused(f"{sid}: a webhook outage needs a positive duration_s")
112	            self._call("/chaos/ingress", {"available": False, "duration_s": duration,
113	                                          "sabotage_id": sid})  # fmt: skip
114	            return f"ingress-outage:{duration:g}s"
115	        raise DeliveryRefused(f"{sid}: no chaos endpoint delivers {cls}")
116

1	"""The incident's proof bundle (spec §7.4, Appendix E.3), written when the incident closes.
2	
3	``emit`` assembles ``bundle.json`` from what the crew recorded while it worked: the case file
4	(G0 cassette, cause report and Intent Record, cards, gate verdicts, decisions, L4 records, the
5	budget plan, costs by role), the incident's ledger entries, the session telemetry journal
6	(``kintsugi.crew.telemetry``) and the facts the ``Incident`` workflow closed with (outcome,
7	traces, canary, shipment, antibody). The case-file artifacts it summarises are copied beside it
8	as attachments, listed by digest in ``attachments.json``; the bundle's own digest goes into the
9	incident's ledger entry as ``bundle_sha256`` (E.2), which audit C1 checks against the file.
10	
11	Nothing is invented: a section the incident never reached (no winner, no canary) is left out,
12	and the sealed sabotage behind an incident is not named here (diagnosis is blind; the reveal
13	after W links them, §6.10). Trace ids recorded only locally (``local:…``) are kept apart from
14	the neatlogs ids audit C8 looks up.
15	"""
16	
17	from __future__ import annotations
18	
19	import json
20	import shutil
21	from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
22	from pathlib import Path
23	from typing import Any
24	
25	from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile
26	from kintsugi.proof.bundle import ProofBundle, write_bundle
27	
28	# Case-file kinds copied into the bundle directory (aggregates only: the information-flow matrix
29	# already keeps holdout tasks and secrets out of the case file).
30	ATTACHED_KINDS = ("cassette", "repro", "intent_record", "cause", "graph_context", "card",
31	                  "outcome", "verdict", "reverify", "decision", "experiment", "plan")  # fmt: skip
32	LOCAL = "local:"
33	
34	
35	def _load(case: CaseFile, kind: str, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
36	    return dict(case._load(kind, name)) if case.exists(kind, name) else {}
37	
38	
39	def _real(ids: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
40	    return [t for t in ids if not str(t).startswith(LOCAL)]
41	
42	
43	def journal_lines(path: Path | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
44	    if path is None or not path.is_file():
45	        return []
46	    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
47	    return [json.loads(line) for line in lines if line.strip()]
48	
49	
50	def _traces(closing: Mapping[str, Any], journal: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
51	    failing = [str(t) for t in (closing.get("traces") or {}).get("failing") or []]
52	    after = [str(t) for t in (closing.get("traces") or {}).get("after") or []]
53	    traces: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
54	    if _real(failing):
55	        traces["failing"] = _real(failing)
56	        traces["before"] = _real(failing)  # tagged phase:before when the incident opened
57	    if _real(after):
58	        traces["after"] = _real(after)
59	    crew = sorted({str(j["trace_id"]) for j in journal if j.get("exported") and j.get("trace_id")})
60	    if crew:
61	        traces["crew"] = crew
62	    local = sorted({t for t in [*failing, *after] if t.startswith(LOCAL)})
63	    return {"traces": traces, "local_traces": local or None}
64	
65	
66	def _cassette(case: CaseFile) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
67	    repro = _load(case, "repro", "g0")
68	    if not repro:
69	        return None
70	    attempts = repro.get("attempts") or []
71	    replays = (attempts[-1].get("evidence") or {}).get("replays_failing") if attempts else None
72	    cassette: dict[str, Any] = {"g0": (f"{replays}/3 fail" if replays is not None
73	                                       else ("reproduced" if repro.get("ok") else
74	                                             "not reproduced"))}  # fmt: skip
75	    if case.exists("cassette", "g0"):
76	        cassette["path"] = "case/cassette/g0.json"
77	    if repro.get("cassette_sha"):
78	        cassette["sha256"] = str(repro["cassette_sha"])
79	    return cassette
80	
81	
82	def _cause(case: CaseFile) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
83	    report = _load(case, "cause", "report")
84	    record = _load(case, "intent_record", "record")
85	    if not report and not record:
86	        return None
87	    cause: dict[str, Any] = {"suspects": list(report.get("suspects") or record.get("suspects")
88	                                              or [])}  # fmt: skip
89	    outputs = [
90	        f"case/{kind}/{name}.json"
91	        for kind, name in (("graph_context", "search"), ("cause", "report"))
92	        if case.exists(kind, name)
93	    ]
94	    if outputs:
95	        cause["graph_outputs"] = outputs
96	    if record:
97	        quotes = record.get("quotes") or record.get("behavioral_contract") or []
98	        cause["intent_record"] = {"checkpoint": record.get("checkpoint"),
99	                                  "commit": record.get("commit"),
100	                                  "quotes": list(quotes) if isinstance(quotes, list)
101	                                  else [str(quotes)]}  # fmt: skip
102	    if report.get("first_bad_checkpoint"):
103	        cause["first_bad_checkpoint"] = str(report["first_bad_checkpoint"])
104	    return cause
105	
106	
107	def _rounds(case: CaseFile) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
108	    by_round: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
109	    for hyp in case.names("card"):
110	        card = _load(case, "card", hyp)
111	        verdict = _load(case, "verdict", hyp)
112	        outcome = _load(case, "outcome", hyp)
113	        entry: dict[str, Any] = {"id": hyp, "checkpoint": outcome.get("checkpoint"),
114	                                 "commit": outcome.get("commit"),
115	                                 "gates": {g: v.get("status") for g, v in
116	                                           (verdict.get("gates") or {}).items()},
117	                                 "passed": verdict.get("passed")}  # fmt: skip
118	        by_round.setdefault(int(card.get("round") or 0), []).append(entry)
119	    return [{"round": rnd, "hyps": hyps} for rnd, hyps in sorted(by_round.items())]
120	
121	
122	def _winner(case: CaseFile, closing: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
123	    winner = closing.get("winner") or {}
124	    hyp = winner.get("hypothesis")
125	    if not hyp:
126	        return None
127	    verdict = _load(case, "verdict", str(hyp))
128	    stats = verdict.get("g4") or {}
129	    return {
130	        "hyp": hyp,
131	        "commit": winner.get("commit_sha"),
132	        "checkpoint": winner.get("checkpoint_id"),
133	        "stats": {k: stats[k] for k in sorted(stats) if not isinstance(stats[k], (dict, list))},
134	    }
135	
136	
137	def _dispute(case: CaseFile) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
138	    names = case.names("experiment")
139	    if not names:
140	        return None
141	    return {name: _load(case, "experiment", name) for name in names}
142	
143	
144	def _reverify(case: CaseFile, closing: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str] | None:
145	    hyp = (closing.get("winner") or {}).get("hypothesis")
146	    names = case.names("reverify")
147	    pick = str(hyp) if hyp and str(hyp) in names else (names[-1] if names else None)
148	    if pick is None:
149	        return None
150	    record = _load(case, "reverify", pick)
151	    return {k: str(v) for k, v in sorted(record.items()) if k.startswith("G")}
152	
153	
154	def _ship(case: CaseFile, closing: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
155	    shipment = closing.get("shipment")
156	    if not shipment:
157	        return None
158	    decision = _load(case, "decision", f"ship-{shipment.get('hypothesis')}")
159	    g7 = decision.get("g7")
160	    return {"pr": shipment.get("pr_url"), "issue": decision.get("issue"),
161	            "branch": shipment.get("branch"), "merged": shipment.get("merged"),
162	            "merge_sha": shipment.get("merge_sha"), "g7_ok": shipment.get("g7_ok"),
163	            "g7": g7 if isinstance(g7, str) else (g7 or {}).get("summary")}  # fmt: skip
164	
165	
166	def _cost(case: CaseFile, journal: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
167	    """``actual_usd`` and ``sessions`` are what audit C10 reconciles (neatlogs session costs)."""
168	    spent = case.spent()
169	    cost: dict[str, Any] = {"total_usd": spent, "actual_usd": spent,
170	                            "by_role": case.costs_by_role()}  # fmt: skip
171	    if journal:  # the crew's traces carried this incident's spend in its neatlogs session
172	        cost["sessions"] = sorted({str(j["session"]) for j in journal if j.get("session")})
173	        cost["telemetry_usd"] = round(sum(float(j.get("cost_usd") or 0.0) for j in journal), 6)
174	    return cost
175	
176	
177	def assemble(
178	    case: CaseFile,
179	    closing: Mapping[str, Any],
180	    *,
181	    ledger_entries: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] = (),
182	    journal: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] = (),
183	    canary: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
184	) -> ProofBundle:
185	    incident = str(closing["incident"])
186	    traces = _traces(closing, journal)
187	    mine = [e for e in ledger_entries if e.get("incident") == incident]
188	    rounds = _rounds(case)
189	    # Beyond E.3 (the model keeps unknown sections): the outcome, the incident's ledger span,
190	    # every attempt's checkpoint, the pinned plan and any local-only trace ids.
191	    extra: dict[str, Any] = {
192	        "outcome": {"state": closing.get("state"), "reason": closing.get("reason"),
193	                    "pass": closing.get("pass", 0),
194	                    "transitions": list(closing.get("transitions") or [])},
195	        "ledger": {"entries": len(mine), "first_seq": mine[0].get("seq") if mine else None,
196	                   "last_hash": mine[-1].get("hash") if mine else None},
197	        "checkpoints": sorted({str(r["checkpoint"]) for rnd in rounds
198	                               for r in rnd["hyps"] if r.get("checkpoint")}),
199	    }  # fmt: skip
200	    if traces["local_traces"]:
201	        extra["local_traces"] = traces["local_traces"]
202	    plan = _load(case, "plan", "plan")
203	    if plan.get("plan_sha"):
204	        extra["plan_sha256"] = str(plan["plan_sha"])
205	    return ProofBundle(
206	        incident=incident,
207	        host=str(closing.get("host") or "unknown"),
208	        traces=traces["traces"],
209	        cassette=_cassette(case),
210	        cause=_cause(case),
211	        rounds=rounds,
212	        dispute=_dispute(case),
213	        winner=_winner(case, closing),
214	        reverify=_reverify(case, closing),
215	        ship=_ship(case, closing),
216	        canary=dict(canary) if canary else None,
217	        cost=_cost(case, journal),
218	        antibody=closing.get("antibody"),
219	        **extra,
220	    )
221	
222	
223	def attach(case: CaseFile, directory: Path, journal_path: Path | None) -> None:
224	    """Copy the summarised case-file artifacts (and the telemetry journal) beside the bundle."""
225	    target = directory / "case"
226	    if target.exists():
227	        shutil.rmtree(target)
228	    for kind in ATTACHED_KINDS:
229	        source = case.root / kind
230	        if source.is_dir():
231	            shutil.copytree(source, target / kind)
232	    costs = case.root / "costs.jsonl"
233	    if costs.is_file():
234	        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

236	    if journal_path is not None and journal_path.is_file():
